1: # BK7258 OpenVela UART0 Mailbox V2完整收发移植方案
2: 
3: ## 1. 文档目标和结论
4: 
5: 本文是`BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md`中UART0和Mailbox V2章节的可实施细化方案。依据当前工作区的OpenVela AP实现、`bk_avdk_smp` AP/CP源码、比赛仓CP覆盖文件、原厂网页文档和生成的内存布局，目标是在不占用CPU1物理UART1、不改变CP物理UART0下载和启动行为的前提下，实现：
6: 
7: ```text
8: AP/OpenVela输出
9:   NuttX console/syslog/NSH stdout
10:     -> AP MB_UART0 TX
11:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x19
12:     -> CP MB_UART0 RX
13:     -> CP shell TX queue
14:     -> CP UART0/GPIO11/CH340/PC
15: 
16: PC输入
17:   PC/CH340/UART0 RX/GPIO10
18:     -> CP shell UART RX owner
19:     -> 显式AP console输入模式
20:     -> CP MB_UART0 TX
21:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x49
22:     -> AP MB_UART0 RX
23:     -> NuttX serial upper-half
24:     -> /dev/console/NSH stdin
25: ```
26: 
27: 最终结论：
28: 
29: - `MB_UART0`本身是全双工、带软件RTS/CTS流控的虚拟UART，不是单向日志命令。
30: - AP发送使用logical channel `0x19`，CP发送使用logical channel `0x49`；两者都是同一个MB_UART0的本端发送编号。
31: - 每个Mailbox V2 envelope只携带16字节message的地址和长度；DATA message再携带固定128字节交换区的地址和有效长度。
32: - 当前本地AP实现只完成AP到CP的输出；收到CP DATA后固定返回成功但不复制数据。当前CP覆盖也只读取AP输出，没有PC到AP输入路径。
33: - 完整移植必须同时修改OpenVela AP和Armino CP。只补AP RX或只调用CP `bk_mb_uart_write()`都不能形成完整控制台。
34: - 正式实现保持原厂16字节message、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS线协议兼容，但必须修复本地实现的buffer所有权、ACK队列、reset、RX校验和NuttX serial接入问题；不得照搬原厂未初始化尾字节、未校验payload指针和失败后静默丢包等缺陷。

50: - AP侧MB_UART0 DATA/STATE、双向ring、流控、ACK和NuttX serial lower-half。
51: - CP侧MB_UART0接收输出和UART0输入转发。
52: - CP CLI与AP NSH对唯一UART0输入的显式所有权切换。
53: - 冷启动、AP重启、CP重启、Mailbox reset和压力验收。
54: 
55: ### 2.3 非目标
56: 
57: - 不启用CPU1物理UART1，不切换GPIO0/1，不要求第二个USB-TTL。
58: - 不用`MB_CHNL_LOG`的`MB_CMD_USER_INPUT`替代逐字节TTY。该协议只能转发完整Armino CLI命令，不具备NSH readline、退格和Ctrl-C语义。
59: - 不修改bootloader下载串口协议。AP console接管只能发生在CP运行期，并且必须在AP ready以后。
60: - 不承诺在Mailbox IRQ和调度器可用前输出启动日志。panic时若中断关闭，MB_UART也不能工作；原厂文档同样明确其不是无中断polling UART。
61: - 第一版不启用MB_UART CRC8。原厂当前配置下CRC恒为0；单边启用会不兼容。保留字段并校验其为0，后续只能在AP/CP同时升级后启用。
62: 
63: ## 3. 已确认的协议事实
64: 
65: ### 3.1 CPU和logical channel编码
66: 
67: logical channel为8位：
68: 
69: ```text
70: bit[7:6] destination CPU
71: bit[5:4] source CPU
72: bit[3:0] logical channel index
73: ```
74: 
75: CPU0/CP为0，CPU1/AP为1。UART0的组内index为9，因此：
76: 
77: | 本端 | 方向 | 发送channel | 接收报文中的channel |
78: | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
79: | AP/OpenVela | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x19` | `0x49` |
80: | CP/Armino | CPU0 -> CPU1 | `0x49` | `0x19` |
81: 
82: 参考：
83: 
84: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:32-44,53,77-96`
85: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:29-41,49,64-83`
86: 
87: 不得将`0x19`和`0x49`理解为两个独立UART，也不得用IPC `0x10`、PWC `0x12/0x42`或`MB_CHNL_LOG`承载UART字节流。
88: 
89: ### 3.2 Mailbox V2 envelope
90: 
91: MBOX0硬件FIFO中的两个data word是：
92: 
93: | FIFO word | 含义 |
94: | --- | --- |
95: | `data[0]` | 发送端稳定16字节message的32位地址 |
96: | `data[1]` | 固定为16 |
97: 
98: 接收端根据硬件SID确认源CPU，再复制16字节message。AP接收的message地址来自CP拥有的稳定SRAM，CP接收的地址来自AP拥有的稳定SRAM。不能让FIFO引用栈变量，也不能在对端复制前复用或改写该slot。
99: 
100: ### 3.3 16字节message header
101: 
102: word0布局固定如下：
103: 
104: ```text
105: bit[7:0]   cmd
106: bit[11:8]  state
107: bit[15:12] ctrl
108: bit[23:16] tx_seq
109: bit[31:24] logical_chnl
110: ```
111: 
112: `ctrl`定义：
113: 
114: | 位 | 名称 | 语义 |
115: | ---: | --- | --- |
116: | 0 | `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX` | 1表示transport ACK，0表示command |
117: | 1 | `CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX` | 无ACK同步发送；正式UART普通路径不使用 |
118: | 2 | `CHNL_CTRL_RESET` | transport重同步 |
119: 
120: `state bit0`为`CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。ACK必须至少匹配`source/destination + logical_chnl + tx_seq + cmd`，不匹配的ACK只能计为stale/bad ACK，不能释放当前事务。
121: 
122: ### 3.4 MB_UART message布局
123: 
124: 协议运行于ARM32 little-endian。不得在OpenVela实现中继续依赖编译器bitfield，使用显式mask/shift和定宽字段。
125: 
126: DATA/STATE command为16字节：
127: 
128: | offset | 大小 | 字段 |
129: | ---: | ---: | --- |
130: | 0 | 1 | `cmd`：DATA=0，STATE=1 |
131: | 1 | 1 | state/ctrl，发送command时初始为0 |
132: | 2 | 1 | transport sequence |
133: | 3 | 1 | logical channel |
134: | 4 | 4 | DATA交换buffer地址；STATE为0 |
135: | 8 | 2 | DATA有效长度1..128；STATE为0 |
136: | 10 | 1 | bit0=`uart_rts`，其余必须0 |
137: | 11 | 1 | `crc8`，当前兼容值为0 |
138: | 12 | 4 | 保留，必须清0 |
139: 
140: ACK为同一个16字节slot的响应语义：
141: 
142: | offset | 含义 |
143: | ---: | --- |
144: | 0..3 | 原cmd、state，加ACK ctrl、sequence和channel |
145: | 4 bit0 | 接收端当前`uart_rts` |
146: | 4 bit1 | `uart_tx_fail`，本DATA整包未接收 |
147: | 4 bit7:2 | 0 |
148: | 5..15 | 0 |
149: 
150: 所有command和ACK结构在构造前必须`memset(..., 0, 16)`，避免原厂实现中offset 12..15栈残留和ACK尾部旧数据泄漏。这是AP/CP同步升级后的正式ABI要求：当前原厂CP command确实可能带非零栈残留，因此CP清零修复必须先于AP启用严格保留字段拒绝策略，不能只升级AP。
151: 
152: ### 3.5 UART0交换区和所有权
153: 
154: 项目RAM布局固定预留：
155: 
156: ```text
157: SWAP = 0x2809f800..0x2809ffff, size 0x800
158: ```
159: 
160: 来自：
161: 
162: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6-10`
163: - 生成的`ram_regions.h`中`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR=0x2809f800`、`CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE=0x800`
164: 
165: 每个支持共享payload的logical channel占`0x200`字节，顺序为HW_CTRL、LOG、UART0、UART1。每个方向/CPU slot为128字节。当前CPU0/CPU1 UART0精确映射为：
166: 
167: | 地址 | owner/方向 | AP视角 |
168: | --- | --- | --- |
169: | `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f` | CP host_tx[CPU1] | AP RX payload，只读后复制 |
170: | `0x2809fc80..0x2809fcff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
171: | `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f` | AP host_rx[CPU1] | AP TX payload，ACK前保持不变 |
172: | `0x2809fd80..0x2809fdff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
173: 
174: OpenVela linker必须新增独立`SWAP` memory region并标记为`NOLOAD`。当前构建顺序是先构建OpenVela、后构建SMP，OpenVela不能读取尚未生成的CP `ram_regions.h`；单一来源固定为比赛仓已提交的`external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`。增加预构建生成/校验脚本，由该CSV同时生成或核对OpenVela board header和linker fragment；最终SMP构建后再与Armino生成的`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/SIZE`自动比较。不能维护两套无校验硬编码。
175: 
176: 不能把SWAP并入AP heap，不能由AP启动代码清零整个SWAP，也不能在AP `.bss`另建一个“看起来等价”的交换buffer。
177: 
178: 首版在`bk7258_start.c`增加显式共享MPU region，并先读取MPU `TYPE.DREGION`确认region预算：CP普通RAM中的envelope窗口为shareable、non-cacheable、RO/XN；CP拥有的UART0 RX payload `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f`为RO/XN；AP拥有的UART0 TX payload `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f`为RW/XN。当前MPU使用`PRIVDEFENA`，未覆盖地址对privileged内核仍可访问，因此CPU2预留slot只能由MB_UART软件白名单/API禁止访问，不能声称由MPU隔离。
179: 
180: 若硬件region数不足以按128字节拆分，才允许将整个SWAP设为RW/XN，但必须记录这是硬件粒度降级并继续以软件白名单强制方向所有权，不能把CP普通RAM扩大为RW。若未来要求硬件阻止访问预留slot，必须关闭`PRIVDEFENA`并完整映射所有必要内存，这不属于本轮UART移植。
181: 
182: 若后续启用D-cache，所有ownership交接统一由共享内存API执行：发布前clean + DMB，读取前invalidate + DMB，ACK后才复用；cache line为32字节，操作必须向外对齐且不能误刷相邻owner数据。

260: ## 6. AP Mailbox V2 transport设计
261: 
262: ### 6.1 物理层
263: 
264: CPU1只配置自己拥有的channel 1：FIFO start=2、length=3，接收IRQ source 63映射到NuttX IRQ79。物理层初始化必须在`up_initialize()`可使用NuttX IRQ API后、board late逻辑服务前完成。
265: 
266: ISR固定执行：
267: 
268: 1. 读取并累计`wrerr/rderr/wrfull`等W1C错误状态。
269: 2. 循环读取FIFO直到empty，不能每次中断只取一个。
270: 3. 校验SID为CPU0、length为16、地址4字节对齐、`address + 16`无溢出且位于CP RAM `0x28064000..0x2809f6ff`。当前CP `mbox0_adapter.c`的envelope slot是可随链接变化的普通`.bss mailbox_buff`，并没有固定地址ABI或32字节对齐，AP不能写死更小窗口。
271: 4. 立即复制到AP-owned RX descriptor queue，随后上层处理；不能长期持有CP message指针。
272: 5. 若RX descriptor queue或ACK资源不足，停止继续drain并保留中断，不能读出后无ACK丢弃。
273: 
274: 初始化时不再盲目drain。应先安装logical callback和RX/ACK资源，再处理已有FIFO。无法识别的有效command也必须返回`COM_FAIL` ACK。
275: 
276: ### 6.2 稳定transaction slot
277: 
278: 每个CPU0物理方向同时只允许一个command in-flight，以兼容原厂physical BUSY模型。实现至少准备：
279: 
280: - 每个logical channel一个16字节pending command副本。
281: - 一个独立16字节active slot；发送后直到ACK/reset完成不可修改。
282: - 至少3个AP-owned ACK slots和一个ACK FIFO，容量不小于硬件RX FIFO深度。
283: - AP新建的active/ACK message slot按32字节对齐并位于AP RAM白名单；接收CP envelope只要求原厂ABI的4字节对齐和CP RAM范围。payload SWAP另行精确校验。
284: 
285: slot释放事件必须明确，因为硬件FIFO保存的是地址而不是16字节值：
286: 
287: - command正常收到匹配ACK后可释放。
288: - command timeout后转为quarantine；发送RESET不释放它。RESET和随后STATE使用各自独立稳定slot。只有STATE收到成功ACK，利用同一AP->CP FIFO顺序证明旧command、RESET和STATE都已被复制后，才一起释放旧command和RESET slot。STATE失败时保持quarantine，直到MBOX硬件重新初始化，不能因进入DOWN就复用。
289: - ACK slot不能以“收到对端下一条command”为释放证据，因为对端timeout后可能绕过旧ACK继续发送。只有本端随后一个同方向、需要ACK的普通事务收到成功ACK，才能证明排在它之前的本端ACK envelope已经被对端复制。
290: - ACK pool达到高水位（建议已占用2/3）时，transport必须立即在所有待发ACK之后调度一个独立稳定slot的STATE probe。probe收到成功ACK后，按本端FIFO发送顺序批量释放排在它之前的ACK slots；probe失败则进入DOWN并保持这些slot quarantine。不能依赖heartbeat或应用数据未来恰好出现。
291: - RESET和SYNC都没有自己的ACK。RESET由紧随其后的成功STATE释放；通用SYNC使用独立slot，并在下一个同方向普通事务成功完成后释放。专用slot尚未释放时再次调用同类旁路发送返回`-EBUSY`，不得有限轮转后覆盖。
292: - ACK在DOWN、ABORTING、PROBING和QUIESCING状态下仍是最高发送优先级；状态变化不能免除已经接收的对端command所需ACK。
293: 
294: CP `mbox0_adapter.c`也按相同原则分别管理command、ACK、RESET和SYNC slot，禁止现有“每次发送无条件轮转两个slot”的做法。
295: 
296: 调度优先级保持原厂“logical index越小优先级越高”：HW_CTRL、PWC优先于UART0，避免日志压力阻塞heartbeat和电源命令。ACK永远高于新command。
297: 
298: ### 6.3 ACK和超时
299: 
300: 收到ACK后完整检查：
301: 
302: ```text
303: SID == CPU0
304: ACK_BOX == 1
305: logical_channel == active.channel
306: tx_seq == active.seq
307: cmd == active.cmd
308: RESET/state/reserved组合合法
309: ```
310: 
311: 匹配成功后才释放active slot并调用logical completion。UART completion再根据`COM_FAIL`和`uart_tx_fail`决定成功或失败。
312: 
313: 超时不得直接修改active buffer并重发。第一版策略：
314: 
315: 1. 200 ms无ACK，标记当前transaction失败并保留错误快照。
316: 2. 停止所有普通新TX，向CPU0发送原厂兼容RESET abort通知；RESET使用独立稳定slot。
317: 3. RESET是`ACK_BOX|RESET`单向通知，CP空闲时会忽略，不返回RESET ACK。AP发送成功后进入PROBING，并用独立slot发送后续MB_UART STATE；不能等待不存在的RESET ACK，也不能复用被abort事务的slot。
318: 4. abort发出或收到peer reset后，所有pending非幂等PWC请求以`-ECONNRESET`完成，不自动重放。
319: 5. UART chunk可保留在本地TX ring，重新交换STATE后最多重发一次；日志允许重复风险时也必须通过计数可见。建议默认不自动重发已经可能被对端消费但ACK丢失的chunk，而是丢弃该chunk并累计`tx_unknown`，避免终端出现重复字符。
320: 6. RESET envelope发送失败或后续STATE仍无ACK则link进入DOWN，heartbeat/ready逻辑可检测并执行既定降级或复位策略。
321: 
322: 8位sequence在每次新transaction递增，0可自然出现；本地abort后建立新的软件epoch。不能仅靠wire sequence解决跨reset的极晚ACK。链路状态统一为`DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING`：ABORTING不发新的普通command，PROBING只发STATE普通command，但所有状态始终优先发送已欠的ACK。
323: 
324: 只有STATE ACK同时满足channel/sequence/cmd匹配、`COM_FAIL==0`、`uart_tx_fail==0`、保留字段合法并成功取得peer RTS时，才能从PROBING进入READY。匹配但带`COM_FAIL`的ACK表示CP尚未open MB_UART0，应在有界退避后继续探测，达到总超时后进入DOWN。
325: 
326: ### 6.4 reset方向
327: 
328: AP transport初始化完成后主动向CP发送一次原厂RESET abort通知，作用是让CP结束可能指向上一个AP boot的in-flight transaction。它不是双向握手：AP不等待响应，而是随后发送STATE探测。收到CP RESET时：
329: 
330: - 对当前active事务生成`-ECONNRESET` completion，但其slot转入quarantine而不复用。反方向收到peer RESET不能证明本端目标FIFO中的旧envelope已经被复制。
331: - 终止本端active/pending outgoing事务并清理其physical busy和peer RTS已知状态；不得清理已经接收且尚未发送的ACK queue。
332: - 保留尚未提交的本地UART TX ring，丢弃不完整AP RX chunk。
333: - 不返回RESET ACK；按原厂语义完成本端abort，再由MB_UART STATE/ACK恢复流控。
334: 
335: CP侧原厂channel层已有处理AP reset并将旧事务以`COM_FAIL`完成的基础逻辑；CP空闲时会直接忽略RESET。上板前需验证当前CP分支未被其他补丁破坏。
336: 
337: quarantine slot只能由后续同方向STATE成功ACK释放，或由明确清空AP->CP目标channel/FIFO的CP侧重初始化、全系统复位释放。AP只重初始化自己的channel 1、IRQ或RX FIFO不能证明CPU0目标FIFO中的旧地址已消失，不得作为释放条件。
338: 
339: ## 7. AP MB_UART0设计
340: 
341: ### 7.1 控制块
342: 
343: AP MB_UART0至少维护：
344: 
345: - `tx_ring`：建议4096或8192字节，用于console/syslog burst，单producer假设不可成立，写入需NuttX spinlock保护。
346: - `rx_ring`：257字节，实际容量256，与原厂语义一致。
347: - 固定AP TX SWAP地址`0x2809fd00`，固定AP RX SWAP地址`0x2809fc00`。
348: - `tx_inflight_len`、`tx_command`、`tx_busy`和`state_pending`。
349: - `local_rts`：AP RX流控；0允许CP发送，1暂停。
350: - `peer_rts`：来自CP command/ACK；0允许AP发送，1暂停。
351: - `rx_irq_enabled`：NuttX serial upper-half当前是否允许接收。
352: - link状态：DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING。
353: - 分项统计：write/drop、DATA/STATE、overflow、bad pointer/length/CRC、remote fail、ACK timeout、reset、high watermark持续时间。
354: 
355: ### 7.2 AP发送
356: 
357: `write()`只把实际可容纳的字节数写入TX ring并返回该字节数，不返回“部分写入后-ENOSPC”这种不可恢复语义。NuttX serial `send()`每次一个字符，syslog bulk write则循环分片并准确报告短写。
358: 
359: 发送条件：link READY、无MB_UART transaction in-flight、`peer_rts==0`、TX ring非空。每次最多取128字节复制到`0x2809fd00`，构造DATA：
360: 
361: ```text
362: cmd_buff     = 0x2809fd00
363: cmd_data_len = min(tx_count, 128)
364: uart_rts     = local_rts
365: crc8         = 0
366: reserved     = 0
367: ```
368: 
369: 与当前本地代码不同，TX ring读指针在成功ACK后才推进。收到`COM_FAIL`或`uart_tx_fail`时不推进；先记录失败并按reset策略处理，避免原厂“提交logical write即消费，ACK失败静默丢失”的缺陷。
370: 
371: 若没有数据但`local_rts`发生变化，发送STATE。DATA ACK本身已携带最新RTS，因此在DATA处理中可合并待发STATE，但不能丢掉最终状态变化。
372: 
373: ### 7.3 AP接收
374: 
375: 收到channel `0x49` command后先验证header，再处理：
376: 
377: DATA必须同时满足：
378: 
379: - `cmd_buff == 0x2809fc00`，不接受“位于SWAP任意位置”或普通CP RAM中的任意指针。
380: - `1 <= cmd_data_len <= 128`，地址加法无溢出。
381: - `crc8 == 0`且保留位为0。
382: - 当前link允许接收。
383: 
384: 接收前执行共享内存acquire/cache invalidate。只有RX ring剩余空间大于等于整包长度时才整包复制；否则整包不复制，设置sticky overflow并在ACK中置`uart_tx_fail=1`。绝不部分接收后报告失败，否则发送端无法确定消费边界。
385: 
386: 无论DATA还是STATE，都更新`peer_rts=command.uart_rts`。响应ACK包含最新`local_rts`。成功DATA复制后触发NuttX RX处理；ISR内不运行NSH、不格式化日志。
387: 
388: ### 7.4 RTS/CTS水位
389: 
390: 保持原厂兼容阈值：
391: 
392: - RX ring总数组257字节、容量256。
393: - 剩余空间`<=128`时设置`local_rts=1`，确保已经在途的一个最大128字节chunk仍有明确处理结果。
394: - 应用读取后，occupancy低于102字节时设置`local_rts=0`并发送STATE，提供滞回避免状态抖动。
395: - `peer_rts=1`时AP禁止新DATA，但仍允许必要的ACK、RESET和本端STATE。
396: 
397: 由于NuttX还有一层`uart_dev_s.recv` ring，MB_UART RX ring的RTS必须根据“MB_UART ring可用空间”管理；`uart_recvchars()`应及时搬运到NuttX ring。新的`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` Kconfig必须`select OTHER_UART_SERIALDRIVER`、`select OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`select SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL`，不能只在defconfig手写隐藏symbol；`OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`再通过NuttX console choice选择`SERIAL_CONSOLE`。
398: 
399: 第一版同时启用`SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL_WATERMARKS`，upper/lower watermark固定为75%/25%。NuttX upper-half到达75%时停止继续搬运并保持/拉高MB_UART RTS；低于25%后重新调用搬运并释放RTS。若不启watermark选项，NuttX只会在full/empty回调，不能声称具备本文的高低水位行为。
400: 
401: ### 7.5 NuttX serial接入
402: 
403: 正式设备不再冒充物理UART1：
404: 
405: - 注册`/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`到同一个Mailbox UART device。
406: - 删除`CONFIG_UART1_SERIALDRIVER`、`CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`BK7258_AP_UART1`误导配置。
407: - 新增板级`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE`选择，并让NuttX console宏映射到该虚拟设备。
408: - 不执行任何UART1 clock、pinmux或GPIO0/1配置。
409: 
410: `uart_ops_s`实现：
411: 
412: | op | 行为 |
413: | --- | --- |
414: | `setup/attach` | 确认MB_UART已注册callback，不能重复初始化physical mailbox |
415: | `shutdown/detach` | 普通console关闭不销毁全局heartbeat共用transport |
416: | `receive` | 从MB_UART RX ring弹出1字节，status返回overflow/parity sticky快照 |
417: | `rxavailable` | 查询MB_UART RX ring非空 |
418: | `rxint` | 保存enable；enable时投递RX worker或调用受控`uart_recvchars()` |
419: | `send` | 写一个字节到MB_UART TX ring；只在`txready`为true时由upper-half调用 |
420: | `txint` | enable时调用`uart_xmitchars()`，ACK/CTS恢复后再次kick |
421: | `txready` | link ready、TX ring有空间；不要求物理channel当前idle |
422: | `txempty` | NuttX xmit ring、MB_UART TX ring和active DATA都为空 |
423: | `rxflowcontrol` | upper-half高水位时拉高local RTS，恢复时拉低并kick RX |
424: 
425: Mailbox ISR只将DATA复制到MB_UART RX ring并post一个高优先级worker/semaphore。worker调用`uart_recvchars()`，避免在硬件Mailbox ISR里进入完整TTY路径。TX ACK或peer RTS从1变0时，同样由worker调用`uart_xmitchars()`。
426: 
427: ### 7.6 syslog和early putc
428: 
429: - transport ready前允许写入一个小型有界early TX ring；满后丢弃并计数，不阻塞启动。
430: - transport ready后由MB_UART worker排空early数据。
431: - bulk syslog按`size_t`循环，每次传入不超过`UINT16_MAX`，返回实际接受字节数；不能无条件返回原长度。
432: - `sc_force`和`arm_lowputc`仍只能best-effort，不宣称IRQ关闭时可靠。可提供有界flush，例如等待不超过20 ms；禁止永久等待ACK。
433: - 避免console和独立syslog backend重复输出同一条日志。最终配置只能有一个主syslog路径。
434: 
435: ## 8. CP UART0双向桥设计
436: 
437: ### 8.1 唯一MB_UART0 owner
438: 
439: CP只调用一次`bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`。现有`ap_uart0_log_init()`扩展为统一bridge：
440: 
441: - 注册MB_UART RX callback，唤醒AP输出worker。
442: - 注册MB_UART TX callback，唤醒PC输入发送worker。
443: - 使用有界CP->AP TX ring，建议512或1024字节。
444: - worker根据`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`处理部分写入，调用`bk_mb_uart_write()`，直到队列为空或peer RTS暂停。
445: - 暴露drop、partial write、MB_UART status、mode switch和last error统计。
446: 
447: 不得为RX和TX分别初始化两次MB_UART0，也不得让日志服务和console服务分别open channel。
448: 
449: ### 8.2 AP输出模式
450: 
451: 提供两个输出策略，但共享同一个MB_UART RX：
452: 
453: 1. `LOG`模式：保持当前按行添加`ap0: `、50 ms半行flush和有限重试，适合AP后台日志。
454: 2. `RAW_CONSOLE`模式：不添加前缀、不等待换行，收到后立即通过CP shell TX queue输出，保证`nsh>`、echo、退格和ANSI字节透明。
455: 
456: 进入AP交互console时切为RAW；退出后恢复LOG。模式切换前先flush旧的半行缓存，防止旧日志与prompt拼接。CP自身异步日志仍可能插入AP终端，第一版应在RAW模式下抑制非关键CP日志或明确串行化，至少不能从两个线程直接写物理UART0。
457: 
458: ### 8.3 UART0输入所有权
459: 
460: CP shell已拥有物理UART0 RX ISR和buffer，因此路由点放在`shell_task.c`读取UART字节之后、执行`handle_shell_input()`之前。状态固定为：
461: 
462: ```text
463: CP_CLI       所有输入由CP CLI处理
464: AP_CONSOLE   原始输入转发给MB_UART0，CP CLI不再解析
465: ```
466: 
467: 上电默认`CP_CLI`。只有满足以下条件才允许进入`AP_CONSOLE`：
468: 
469: - AP已发送Mailbox RESET abort通知并完成STATE/ACK链路探测。
470: - AP已发送IPC power-up和PWC boot ready。
471: - CP bridge确认MB_UART0可写。
472: 
473: CP CLI新增明确命令，例如`ap_console open`。命令handler只设置`SWITCH_TO_AP_PENDING`，不能立即修改owner：先等待当前命令响应和CP TX queue flush，抑制尾随`cp>`，原子清理`cmd_line_buf`、BK_REG/AT/escape解析状态并通过`SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESET`清物理UART RX残留，之后才进入AP_CONSOLE并打印一次切换提示。
474: 
475: AP_CONSOLE保留一个本地退出转义，建议使用行首`Ctrl-]`后跟`.`；解析器只在行首识别完整转义，其他字节原样转发。退出时进入`SWITCH_TO_CP_PENDING`，丢弃未完成转义、停止接收新AP输入、清理或明确丢弃尚未发送的bridge TX，flush AP RAW输出后再恢复CP parser和prompt。退出转义由CP消费，不发送给NSH。
476: 
477: 禁止把同一字节同时广播给CP CLI和AP NSH，否则两个shell会同时echo/执行。下载工具、ATE和bootloader阶段不进入该状态机，维持原UART0 owner。
478: 
479: ### 8.4 PC输入发送
480: 
481: 在AP_CONSOLE状态，CP shell现有UART RX路径读取到原始字节后：
482: 
483: 1. 先运行最小退出转义状态机。
484: 2. 非转义字节写入CP->AP bridge ring。
485: 3. bridge worker根据MB_UART write-ready发送；不得在UART ISR中调用可能触发Mailbox发送和复杂锁的接口。
486: 4. ring满时优先通过MB_UART RTS自然回压；物理UART0无硬件流控，仍可能在高速粘贴时丢字，必须计数并在退出RAW后报告。
487: 5. 可选的软件输入限速按115200估算，但不得sleep在UART ISR；只能由worker分批发送。
488: 
489: AP link down/reset时CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE，清理未发送输入并恢复CP_CLI，避免用户被锁死在无响应终端。为使该行为可实现，CP `mailbox_channel.c`必须新增peer RESET/physical timeout通知，IPC heartbeat/PWC recovery也要向bridge发布AP_DOWN事件；不能从`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`推断link状态。bridge通过统一event callback处理`AP_READY/AP_DOWN/PEER_RESET`，并在事件中只唤醒worker，不直接操作shell队列。
490: 
491: ### 8.5 CP原厂驱动最小加固
492: 
493: 在不改变线协议的前提下同步修复：
494: 
495: - `mb_uart_init()`第二个NULL检查应为`rx_xchg_buff`。
496: - DATA RX校验`cmd_buff`必须等于本端预期`rx_xchg_buff`，长度1..128。
497: - 所有command/response先清零保留字段。
498: - bridge必须正确处理`bk_mb_uart_write()`部分写和`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`。
499: - `mailbox_channel.c`向bridge暴露peer reset/timeout通知；收到AP reset时即使CP physical TX为空也必须发布事件，而不是只记fault后静默返回。
500: 
501: 原厂驱动在logical write成功时提前推进TX ring，远端`uart_tx_fail`时不会回滚。若不重写CP mb_uart状态机，CP输入可靠性仍低于AP改进实现。正式交付建议把CP TX也改为“ACK成功后推进ring”，但这会扩大原厂代码改动。实施可分两步：先完成兼容双向链路并测出失败路径，再将该加固作为进入压力验收前的必做项，而不是长期保留静默丢输入行为。
502: 
503: ## 9. 启动、ready和恢复时序
504: 
505: ### 9.1 CP时序
506: 
507: ```text
508: CP bootloader/download UART0保持原行为
509:   -> CP UART0 115200 8N1和shell初始化
510:   -> Mailbox V2 physical/channel初始化
511:   -> MB_UART0唯一bridge init，注册RX/TX callback
512:   -> 默认CP_CLI模式
513:   -> 启动AP
514:   -> 等待AP IPC power-up
515:   -> 等待AP PWC boot ready
516:   -> 允许用户执行ap_console open
517: ```
518: 
519: ### 9.2 AP时序
520: 
521: ```text
522: CPU1 reset
523:   -> MPU/vector/基础NuttX启动
524:   -> 注册有界early syslog，不访问UART1
525:   -> up_initialize调用arm_serialinit
526:   -> arm_serialinit在uart_register前初始化MBOX0 IRQ79和RX资源
527:   -> 初始化logical transport、ACK pool和MB_UART0 rings/SWAP/callback
528:   -> 创建Mailbox/UART RX/TX worker；允许其在调度器运行后启动
529:   -> 发送单向RESET abort通知，不等待RESET ACK
530:   -> 异步发送STATE(local_rts=0)，arm_serialinit不阻塞等待
531:   -> 注册/dev/console和/dev/ttyMB0
532:   -> board late在worker已运行后有界等待STATE transport ACK
533:   -> 发送IPC power-up并确认transport ACK
534:   -> 启动heartbeat和PWC worker
535:   -> 发送PWC boot ready
536:   -> 启动NSH
537: ```
538: 
539: `arm_serialinit()`运行在公共`up_initialize()`中，OS/driver服务可用，但不得依赖用户初始化线程已经运行，因此这里只安装全部资源并异步kick。STATE ACK的有界等待放到board late，此时worker和系统tick已明确运行。
540: 
541: ready门禁新增：MB_UART RX已能整包复制并调用NuttX worker，TX/STATE完成至少一次探测。日志输出失败不能无限阻塞heartbeat；有界失败后记录link状态，并按产品策略决定继续无console运行还是拒绝ready。比赛调试固件建议MB_UART失败时拒绝ready，避免出现“系统似乎启动但唯一console不可用”。
542: 
543: ### 9.3 suspend/resume和重启
544: 
545: 首版若未完整实现Mailbox PM，必须对相关deep sleep投票禁止进入，不能让CP关闭共享资源后AP仍认为link READY。
546: 
547: 实现PM后流程：
548: 
549: - suspend：停止新DATA，等待active有界完成，拉高RTS，发送STATE，保存统计并关闭IRQ route。
550: - resume：重配CPU1 FIFO/IRQ、清W1C错误、发送单向RESET abort通知、用STATE/ACK探测，再恢复DATA。
551: - AP重启：AP主动发送RESET abort通知；CP transport发布PEER_RESET/AP_DOWN事件，bridge将旧AP TX以失败完成并自动退出AP_CONSOLE。
552: - CP重启：AP ACK timeout进入ABORTING/DOWN，不继续写旧payload；CP恢复后重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测。

589: 比赛仓当前external镜像尚未包含完整CP源码树。实施前要把所有实际修改文件加入权威覆盖目录并更新`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`的同步表和命令，不能只保留一个`driver.c`覆盖而遗漏shell/mb_uart改动。
590: 
591: ## 11. 分阶段实施
592: 
593: ### 阶段A：协议和内存固化
594: 
595: 1. 在AP代码中定义显式wire结构、mask和static assert。
596: 2. 先在CP `mb_uart_driver.c`完成command/ACK全量清零、payload指针/长度校验和NULL检查；AP严格检查保留字段以此为前置条件。
597: 3. linker加入SWAP，不清零、不进heap；构建map确认`0x2809f800..0x2809ffff`唯一。
598: 4. 写主机侧单元测试验证channel编码、header pack/unpack、地址溢出和精确payload白名单。
599: 
600: 出口：离线测试能精确生成与原厂一致的16字节DATA/STATE/ACK。
601: 
602: ### 阶段B：transport可靠化
603: 
604: 1. 修复MBOX0初始化盲目drain和错误状态。
605: 2. AP实现active command、ACK稳定slot/queue、完整ACK关联和单向reset abort；CP adapter同步改为command/ACK专用稳定slot。
606: 3. 先用HW_CTRL/PWC回归，不接console大流量。
607: 
608: 出口：power-up、heartbeat和PWC ready都收到ACK；注入FIFO full/stale ACK不会永久busy。
609: 
610: ### 阶段C：AP MB_UART全双工
611: 
612: 1. 加入固定SWAP TX/RX、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS。
613: 2. 完成NuttX serial RX和`uart_recvchars()` worker。
614: 3. 设备改名`ttyMB0`并移除UART1配置。
615: 
616: 出口：用CP测试任务调用`bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, "help\n", 5)`可驱动NSH，AP输出可返回CP。
617: 
618: ### 阶段D：CP UART0桥
619: 
620: 1. 扩展唯一MB_UART0 bridge和RAW/LOG输出。
621: 2. 在CP shell现有输入owner中加入模式切换，不注册第二个UART ISR。
622: 3. 加入延迟生效的owner切换、退出转义、transport/heartbeat事件驱动的link-down自动回退和统计命令。
623: 
624: 出口：单根Type-C上可从CP CLI进入AP NSH、交互、退出并恢复CP CLI。
625: 
626: ### 阶段E：恢复和压力
627: 
628: 1. AP/CP reset、ACK timeout、FIFO full、RX overflow、RTS持续和高速粘贴故障注入。
629: 2. heartbeat/PWC/日志/输入并发。
630: 3. PM未完成则验证sleep vote确实阻止破坏link；完成后验证suspend/resume重握手。
631: 
632: 出口：满足第12节全部验收标准后，才删除旧output-only兼容代码和UART1命名。
633: 
634: ## 12. 测试和验收矩阵
635: 
636: ### 12.1 构建和静态检查
637: 
638: - OpenVela AP `-Werror`构建通过；最终SMP `all-app.bin`完整构建通过。
639: - map中SWAP地址、大小、NOLOAD和AP heap边界正确；AP TX/RX指针分别固定为`0x2809fd00/0x2809fc00`。
640: - GPIO0/1没有UART1 pinmux，二进制无物理UART1 console初始化。
641: - CP覆盖副本与`bk_avdk_smp`目标文件`cmp -s`一致。
642: - 静态扫描不存在ISR内sleep、无界semaphore wait、printf或直接阻塞UART0输出。
643: 
644: ### 12.2 功能
645: 
646: | 用例 | 预期 |
647: | --- | --- |
648: | CP冷启动 | CP log和CP prompt正常，默认不劫持UART0输入 |
649: | AP启动 | 出现带`ap0:`的OpenVela日志，heartbeat无超时 |
650: | `ap_console open` | 切入RAW，出现`nsh>`且prompt无50 ms按行前缀改写 |
651: | NSH输入 | 字母、回车、退格、方向键、Ctrl-C均按TTY语义工作 |
652: | 退出转义 | 不传给AP，恢复CP prompt和LOG模式 |
653: | AP长输出 | 大于128字节正确分片、顺序一致、无覆盖 |
654: | PC高速粘贴 | RTS发生且系统不死锁；超出物理能力时drop计数可见 |
655: | `poll/read` | `/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`的POLLIN、blocking/nonblocking语义正确 |
656: 
657: ### 12.3 故障和并发
658: 
659: - 注入非法envelope地址、长度、SID、channel、payload地址、129字节长度和非零保留位，均拒绝且计数；有效command收到`COM_FAIL` ACK，不拖死CP physical channel。
660: - ACK FIFO满时不覆盖旧ACK；停止drain或受控恢复。
661: - 丢失DATA ACK后不原地改写in-flight slot，不出现无限重复字符。
662: - stale/wrong cmd/wrong sequence ACK不能释放当前事务。
663: - RX ring不足时整包拒绝，`uart_tx_fail=1`，不部分注入NSH。
664: - AP重启期间CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE；重启后旧输入和旧输出不重放。
665: - CP重启后AP进入DOWN并重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测，无永久`peer_rts=1`。
666: - 连续10 MiB AP输出、1 MiB双向随机字节和1小时交互期间，heartbeat、PWC和CP UART0不失效。
667: - UART压力下HW_CTRL/PWC优先于UART0，ready和heartbeat延迟有上界。
668: 
669: ### 12.4 最低可观察结果
670: 
671: ```text
672: CP boot...
673: ap0: OpenVela mailbox uart ready
674: cp> ap_console open
675: nsh> uname -a
676: ...
677: nsh>                         # 行首 Ctrl-] .
678: AP console closed
679: cp>
680: ```
681: 
682: 统计命令至少输出：link/mode、peer/local RTS、TX/RX ring occupancy、active channel/seq/cmd、DATA/STATE计数、drop、overflow、remote fail、bad envelope/payload/ACK、timeout和reset次数。
683: 
684: ## 13. 风险和明确决策
685: 
686: 1. **唯一物理UART复用风险**：UART0同时服务下载、CP shell、CP log和AP console。通过运行期显式owner切换解决，不在bootloader阶段透明桥接。
687: 2. **原厂协议无端到端可靠序号**：transport sequence只关联单次message，ACK丢失后无法判断对端是否已消费。正式策略优先避免重复输入，记录`tx_unknown`并reset，而不是盲目重发。
688: 3. **物理UART无硬件流控**：Mailbox RTS只能限制CP到AP交换，不能让CH340停止已经到达CP UART FIFO的数据。高速粘贴仍需有界CP ring和可见drop。
689: 4. **panic日志限制**：MB_UART依赖中断，不能冒充真正polling UART。验收只要求正常调度和可屏蔽短临界区下工作，不承诺hard-fault关中断后的完整日志。
690: 5. **SMP并发**：当前AP为单核时可用local IRQ lock；正式启用CPU2前，transport和ring必须切换为NuttX SMP-safe spinlock并明确CPU1 owner或跨核代理。
691: 6. **cache**：首版SWAP non-cacheable。任何启cache改动必须两端同时验证，不能只加一个DMB就宣称安全。
692: 7. **CP改动维护成本**：完整输入owner必须修改shell路径，而不是只改`driver.c`。这些文件必须纳入external覆盖和构建说明，否则下一次清理构建会丢失功能。
693: 
694: ## 14. 参考源码索引

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "irq.h"
19: 
20: #define MBOX_REG(n)             (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
21: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG            MBOX_REG(0x20)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG       MBOX_REG(0x21)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x22)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x23)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_TID            MBOX_REG(0x24)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_SID            MBOX_REG(0x25)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x26)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x27)
29: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x28)
30: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x18)
31: #define MBOX_CTRL               MBOX_REG(2)
32: 
33: #define MBOX_CFG_INT_EN         (1u << 8)
34: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN       (1u << 9)
35: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN       (1u << 10)
36: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN      (1u << 11)
37: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS   (1u << 16)
38: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS   (1u << 17)
39: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS  (1u << 18)
40: #define MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS   (MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS | \
41:                                  MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS | \
42:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)
43: #define MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK        0x00000fffu
44: 
45: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      3u
46: 
47: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
48: {
49:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
50: };
51: 
52: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
53: static bk7258_mbox_rx_ready_t g_rx_ready;
54: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
55: static uint8_t g_rx_head;
56: static uint8_t g_rx_tail;
57: static bool g_mbox_ready;
58: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
59: 
60: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
61: {
62:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
63: }
64: 
65: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
66: {
67:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
68:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
69: 
70:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
71:     {
72:       g_stats.write_error++;
73:     }
74: 
75:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.read_error++;
78:     }
79: 
80:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
81:     {
82:       g_stats.write_full++;
83:     }
84: 
85:   if (errors != 0)
86:     {
87:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
88:     }
89: }
90: 
91: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
92:                                 uint32_t length)
93: {
94:   if (source != 0)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_source++;
97:       return false;
98:     }
99: 
100:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
101:     {
102:       g_stats.bad_length++;
103:       return false;
104:     }
105: 
106:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
107:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
108:     {
109:       g_stats.bad_address++;
110:       return false;
111:     }
112: 
113:   return true;
114: }
115: 
116: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
117: {
118:   uintptr_t status;
119: 
120:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
121:     {
122:       return -EINVAL;
123:     }
124: 
125:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
126:    * receive FIFO status register.
127:    */
128: 
129:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS : MBOX_CH1_STATUS;
130:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
131:     {
132:       return -EAGAIN;
133:     }
134: 
135:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
136:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
137:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
138:   return OK;
139: }
140: 
141: static bool mbox_desc_full(void)
142: {
143:   return (uint8_t)((g_rx_head + 1u) % MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT) == g_rx_tail;
144: }
145: 
146: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
147: {
148:   (void)irq;
149:   (void)context;
150:   (void)arg;
151: 
152:   mbox_clear_errors();
153: 
154:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
155:     {
156:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
157:       uint32_t address;
158:       uint32_t length;
159:       uint8_t source;
160: 
161:       /* Do not pop a valid command unless the logical layer can preserve
162:        * the response in an AP-owned ACK slot.
163:        */
164: 
165:       if (mbox_desc_full() || (g_rx_ready != NULL && !g_rx_ready()))
166:         {
167:           break;
168:         }
169: 
170:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
171:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
172:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
173:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
174:         {
175:           continue;
176:         }
177: 
178:       desc = &g_rx_desc[g_rx_head];
179:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
180:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
181:              sizeof(desc->message));
182:       g_rx_head = (g_rx_head + 1u) % MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT;
183:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
184: 
185:       while (g_rx_tail != g_rx_head)
186:         {
187:           desc = &g_rx_desc[g_rx_tail];
188:           if (g_callback != NULL)
189:             {
190:               g_callback(&desc->message);
191:             }
192: 
193:           g_rx_tail = (g_rx_tail + 1u) % MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT;
194:         }
195:     }
196: 
197:   return OK;
198: }
199: 
200: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback,
201:                               bk7258_mbox_rx_ready_t ready)
202: {
203:   g_callback = callback;
204:   g_rx_ready = ready;
205: }
206: 
207: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
208: {
209:   irqstate_t flags;
210: 
211:   if (stats == NULL)
212:     {
213:       return;
214:     }
215: 
216:   flags = up_irq_save();
217:   *stats = g_stats;
218:   up_irq_restore(flags);
219: }
220: 
221: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
222: {
223:   int ret;
224: 
225:   if (g_mbox_ready)
226:     {
227:       return OK;
228:     }
229: 
230:   g_rx_head = 0;
231:   g_rx_tail = 0;
232:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
233: 
234:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
235:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
236:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
237:    */
238: 
239:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
240:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
241:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
242:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
243:   mbox_clear_errors();
244: 
245:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
246:   if (ret < 0)
247:     {
248:       return ret;
249:     }
250: 
251:   g_mbox_ready = true;
252:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
253:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
254:   return OK;
255: }

2:  * BK7258 Mailbox V2 logical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
17: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
18: 
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: 
21: #define MB_CHANNEL_COUNT       3u
22: #define MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT      8u
23: #define MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER      3u
24: #define MB_TIMEOUT             MSEC2TICK(200)
25: #define MB_WORK_INTERVAL       MSEC2TICK(10)
26: #define MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS  3u
27: 
28: enum ack_slot_state
29: {
30:   ACK_SLOT_FREE = 0,
31:   ACK_SLOT_QUEUED,
32:   ACK_SLOT_SENT
33: };
34: 
35: struct logical_channel
36: {
37:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message pending;
38:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
39:   void *arg;
40:   int result;
41:   bool queued;
42: };
43: 
44: struct active_transaction
45: {
46:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
47:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
48:   void *arg;
49:   clock_t started;
50:   uint32_t order;
51:   uint8_t channel_index;
52:   bool busy;
53:   bool quarantine;
54: };
55: 
56: struct ack_slot
57: {
58:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
59:   uint32_t order;
60:   enum ack_slot_state state;
61: };
62: 
63: struct transport_stats
64: {
65:   uint32_t tx;
66:   uint32_t rx;
67:   uint32_t fifo_full;
68:   uint32_t timeout;
69:   uint32_t bad_ack;
70:   uint32_t bad_header;
71:   uint32_t unsupported;
72:   uint32_t ack_overflow;
73:   uint32_t resets;
74:   uint32_t probes;
75:   uint32_t probe_fail;
76: };
77: 
78: static const uint8_t g_channel_ids[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT] =
79: {
80:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX,
81:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_TX,
82:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX
83: };
84: 
85: static struct logical_channel g_channels[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT];
86: static struct active_transaction g_active;
87: static struct active_transaction g_probe;
88: static struct ack_slot g_ack_slots[MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT];
89: static struct bk7258_mb_wire_message g_reset_slot
90:   __attribute__((aligned(32)));
91: static struct transport_stats g_stats;
92: static bk7258_mb_channel_rx_t g_uart_rx;
93: static void *g_uart_rx_arg;
94: static void (*g_pwc_rx)(const void *message);
95: static bk7258_mb_link_callback_t g_link_callback;
96: static void *g_link_arg;
97: static sem_t g_tx_sem;
98: static uint32_t g_send_order;
99: static uint8_t g_tx_seq;
100: static enum bk7258_mb_link_state g_link_state;
101: static enum bk7258_mb_link_state g_reported_state;
102: static bool g_initialized;
103: static bool g_physical_started;
104: static bool g_reset_pending;
105: static bool g_reset_sent;
106: static bool g_probe_requested;
107: static uint8_t g_probe_attempts;
108: 
109: static unsigned int channel_index(uint8_t channel)
110: {
111:   unsigned int i;
112: 
113:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
114:     {
115:       if (g_channel_ids[i] == channel)
116:         {
117:           return i;
118:         }
119:     }
120: 
121:   return MB_CHANNEL_COUNT;
122: }
123: 
124: static unsigned int ack_slots_used(void)
125: {
126:   unsigned int count = 0;
127:   unsigned int i;
128: 
129:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
130:     {
131:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_FREE)
132:         {
133:           count++;
134:         }
135:     }
136: 
137:   return count;
138: }
139: 
140: static bool transport_rx_ready(void)
141: {
142:   irqstate_t flags;
143:   bool ready;
144: 
145:   flags = up_irq_save();
146:   ready = ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT;
147:   up_irq_restore(flags);
148:   return ready;
149: }
150: 
151: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
152:                      uint32_t *order)
153: {
154:   uint32_t wire[2];
155:   int ret;
156: 
157:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
158:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
159:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
160:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
161:   if (ret == OK)
162:     {
163:       *order = ++g_send_order;
164:       g_stats.tx++;
165:     }
166:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
167:     {
168:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
169:     }
170: 
171:   return ret;
172: }
173: 
174: static void release_acks_before(uint32_t order)
175: {
176:   unsigned int i;
177: 
178:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
179:     {
180:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_SENT &&
181:           g_ack_slots[i].order < order)
182:         {
183:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
184:         }
185:     }
186: }
187: 
188: static void set_link_state(enum bk7258_mb_link_state state)
189: {
190:   if (g_link_state != state)
191:     {
192:       g_link_state = state;
193:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
194:     }
195: }
196: 
197: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
198:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
199:                                  int result)
200: {
201:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
202: 
203:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
204:     {
205:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
206:       channel->queued = false;
207:       channel->result = result;
208:     }
209: 
210:   if (active->callback != NULL)
211:     {
212:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
213:     }
214: 
215:   active->busy = false;
216:   if (result == OK)
217:     {
218:       release_acks_before(active->order);
219:     }
220: }
221: 
222: static void fail_pending(int result)
223: {
224:   unsigned int i;
225: 
226:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
227:     {
228:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
229: 
230:       if (channel->queued)
231:         {
232:           channel->queued = false;
233:           channel->result = result;
234:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
235:             {
236:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
237:             }
238:         }
239:     }
240: }
241: 
242: static void begin_abort(int result)
243: {
244:   if (g_active.busy)
245:     {
246:       g_active.quarantine = true;
247:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
248:     }
249: 
250:   if (g_probe.busy)
251:     {
252:       g_probe.quarantine = true;
253:       complete_transaction(&g_probe, NULL, result);
254:     }
255: 
256:   fail_pending(result);
257:   /* A RESET slot remains owned until a subsequent STATE is acknowledged.
258:    * If another abort arrives meanwhile, keep its bytes stable and continue
259:    * probing instead of writing a second envelope for the same slot.
260:    */
261: 
262:   g_reset_pending = !g_reset_sent;
263:   g_probe_requested = false;
264:   set_link_state(g_reset_pending ? BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING :
265:                                   BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
266: }
267: 
268: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
269: {
270:   unsigned int i;
271: 
272:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
273:     {
274:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
275:         {
276:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
277:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
278:         }
279:     }
280: 
281:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
282:   return NULL;
283: }
284: 
285: static int dispatch_locked(void)
286: {
287:   struct active_transaction *active;
288:   struct logical_channel *channel;
289:   unsigned int i;
290:   int ret;
291: 
292:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
293: 
294:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
295:     {
296:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
297:         {
298:           continue;
299:         }
300: 
301:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
302:       if (ret < 0)
303:         {
304:           return ret;
305:         }
306: 
307:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
308:     }
309: 
310:   if (g_reset_pending)
311:     {
312:       uint32_t order;
313: 
314:       ret = send_slot(&g_reset_slot, &order);
315:       if (ret < 0)
316:         {
317:           return ret;
318:         }
319: 
320:       g_reset_pending = false;
321:       g_reset_sent = true;
322:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
323:     }
324: 
325:   if (g_active.busy || g_probe.busy)
326:     {
327:       return OK;
328:     }
329: 
330:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
331:     {
332:       channel = &g_channels[i];
333:       if (!channel->queued)
334:         {
335:           continue;
336:         }
337: 
338:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
339:         {
340:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
341:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
342:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
343:             {
344:               continue;
345:             }
346: 
347:           active = &g_probe;
348:           if (active->quarantine)
349:             {
350:               return -ENOLINK;
351:             }
352:         }
353:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
354:         {
355:           active = &g_active;
356:           if (active->quarantine)
357:             {
358:               return -ENOLINK;
359:             }
360:         }
361:       else
362:         {
363:           return OK;
364:         }
365: 
366:       memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
367:       memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending, sizeof(active->message));
368:       active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
369:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
370:         bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
371:         g_channel_ids[i]);
372:       active->callback = channel->callback;
373:       active->arg = channel->arg;
374:       active->channel_index = i;
375:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
376:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
377:       if (ret < 0)
378:         {
379:           return ret;
380:         }
381: 
382:       active->busy = true;
383:       if (active == &g_probe)
384:         {
385:           g_probe_attempts++;
386:           g_stats.probes++;
387:         }
388: 
389:       return OK;
390:     }
391: 
392:   return OK;
393: }
394: 
395: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
396:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
397: {
398:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
399: 
400:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
401:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
402:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
403:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
404:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
405:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
406:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
407: }
408: 
409: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
410: {
411:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
412:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
413:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
414: }
415: 
416: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
417: {
418:   struct active_transaction *active;
419:   int result;
420: 
421:   active = g_probe.busy ? &g_probe : &g_active;
422:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
423:     {
424:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
425:       return;
426:     }
427: 
428:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
429:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
430:     {
431:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
432: 
433:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
434:       return;
435:     }
436: 
437:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
438:     {
439:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
440:       return;
441:     }
442: 
443:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
444:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
445: 
446:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
447:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
448:     {
449:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
450:     }
451: 
452:   release_acks_before(active->order);
453: 
454:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
455: 
456:   if (active == &g_probe)
457:     {
458:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
459:         {
460:           g_active.quarantine = false;
461:           g_probe.quarantine = false;
462:           g_reset_sent = false;
463:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
464:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
465:         }
466:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
467:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
468:         {
469:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
470:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
471:            */
472:         }
473:       else
474:         {
475:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
476:           g_probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
477:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
478:         }
479:     }
480: 
481:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
482:            result < 0)
483:     {
484:       begin_abort(result);
485:     }
486: 
487:   (void)dispatch_locked();
488: }
489: 
490: static void handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
491: {
492:   struct ack_slot *slot;
493:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
494:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
495:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
496:   uint8_t state = 0;
497:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
498: 
499:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
500:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
501:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
502:     {
503:       g_stats.bad_header++;
504:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
505:     }
506:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
507:     {
508:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
509:       if (ret < 0)
510:         {
511:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
512:         }
513:     }
514:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
515:     {
516:       g_pwc_rx(message);
517:       ret = OK;
518:     }
519:   else
520:     {
521:       g_stats.unsupported++;
522:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
523:     }
524: 
525:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
526:     {
527:       return;
528:     }
529: 
530:   slot = alloc_ack_slot();
531:   if (slot == NULL)
532:     {
533:       return;
534:     }
535: 
536:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
537:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
538:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
539:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
540:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
541: 
542:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
543:     {
544:       g_probe_requested = true;
545:     }
546: 
547:   (void)dispatch_locked();
548: }
549: 
550: static void mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
551: {
552:   irqstate_t flags;
553:   uint8_t control;
554: 
555:   flags = up_irq_save();
556:   g_stats.rx++;
557:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
558: 
559:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
560:     {
561:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
562:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
563:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
564:         {
565:           g_stats.bad_header++;
566:         }
567:       else
568:         {
569:           g_stats.resets++;
570:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
571:         }
572:     }
573:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
574:     {
575:       handle_ack(message);
576:     }
577:   else
578:     {
579:       handle_command(message);
580:     }
581: 
582:   up_irq_restore(flags);
583:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
584: }

586: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
587: {
588:   (void)argc;
589:   (void)argv;
590: 
591:   for (;;)
592:     {
593:       irqstate_t flags;
594:       bool request_probe;
595: 
596:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
597:       flags = up_irq_save();
598: 
599:       if ((g_active.busy &&
600:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
601:           (g_probe.busy &&
602:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_probe.started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
603:         {
604:           g_stats.timeout++;
605:           if (g_probe.busy)
606:             {
607:               g_probe.quarantine = true;
608:               complete_transaction(&g_probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
609:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
610:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
611:             }
612:           else
613:             {
614:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
615:             }
616:         }
617: 
618:       (void)dispatch_locked();
619:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&

304:   else if (!failed)

306:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
307:         {
308:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
309:           failed = true;
310:           malformed = true;
311:         }
312:       else
313:         {
314:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
315:         }
316:     }
317: 
318:   if (!malformed)
319:     {
320:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
321: 
322:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
323:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
324:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
325:         {
326:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
327:         }
328:     }
329: 
330:   update_local_rts();
331:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
332:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
333:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
334: }

336: static int send_state_locked(void)
337: {
338:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
339:   int ret;
340: 
341:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
342:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_STATE, 0, 0, 0,
343:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
344:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
345:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
346:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
347:   if (ret == OK)
348:     {
349:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
350:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_STATE;
351:       g_uart.state_pending = false;
352:       g_uart.stats.state_tx++;
353:     }
354: 
355:   return ret;
356: }
357: 
358: static int send_data_locked(void)
359: {
360:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
361:   uint8_t *destination =
362:     (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
363:   uint16_t length = tx_count();
364:   uint16_t first;
365:   int ret;
366: 
367:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
368:     {
369:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
370:     }
371: 
372:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)
373:     {
374:       return -EAGAIN;
375:     }
376: 
377:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
378:   if (first > length)
379:     {
380:       first = length;
381:     }
382: 
383:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
384:   if (first != length)
385:     {
386:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
387:     }
388: 
389:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
390:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
391:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
392:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
393:   message.payload_length = length;
394:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
395:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
396:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
397:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
398:   if (ret == OK)
399:     {
400:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
401:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
402:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
403:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
404:     }
405: 
406:   return ret;
407: }

409: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
410: {
411:   (void)argc;
412:   (void)argv;
413: 
414:   for (;;)
415:     {
416:       irqstate_t flags;
417:       bool reset;
418: 
419:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
420:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
421:       flags = up_irq_save();
422:       reset = g_uart.reset_pending;
423:       g_uart.reset_pending = false;
424: 
425:       if (!reset && !g_uart.transaction_busy)
426:         {
427:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
428: 
429:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
430:             {
431:               (void)send_state_locked();
432:             }
433:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
434:             {
435:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
436:                 {
437:                   (void)send_state_locked();
438:                 }
439:               else
440:                 {
441:                   (void)send_data_locked();
442:                 }
443:             }
444:         }
445: 
446:       up_irq_restore(flags);
447:       if (reset)
448:         {
449:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
450:           bk7258_mailbox_force_reset();
451:           flags = up_irq_save();
452:           g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
453:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
454:           up_irq_restore(flags);
455:         }
456: 
457:       if (g_uart.callback != NULL)
458:         {
459:           g_uart.callback(g_uart.callback_arg);
460:         }
461:     }
462: 
463:   return OK;
464: }

535: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
536: {
537:   irqstate_t flags;
538:   uint16_t available;
539:   uint16_t written;
540:   uint16_t first;
541: 
542:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)
543:     {
544:       return -EINVAL;
545:     }
546: 
547:   if (length == 0)
548:     {
549:       return 0;
550:     }
551: 
552:   flags = up_irq_save();
553:   available = tx_free();
554:   written = length > available ? available : length;
555:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
556:   if (first > written)
557:     {
558:       first = written;
559:     }
560: 
561:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
562:   if (first != written)
563:     {
564:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
565:     }
566: 
567:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
568:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
569:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
570:   if (written < length)
571:     {
572:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
573:     }
574: 
575:   up_irq_restore(flags);
576:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
577:     {
578:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
579:     }
580: 
581:   return written;
582: }

584: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_read(uint8_t *data, size_t length,
585:                               unsigned int *status)
586: {
587:   irqstate_t flags;
588:   uint16_t available;
589:   uint16_t count;
590:   uint16_t first;
591: 
592:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
593:     {
594:       return -EINVAL;
595:     }
596: 
597:   flags = up_irq_save();
598:   available = rx_count();
599:   count = length > available ? available : length;
600:   first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_read;
601:   if (first > count)
602:     {
603:       first = count;
604:     }
605: 
606:   memcpy(data, &g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_read], first);
607:   if (first != count)
608:     {
609:       memcpy(data + first, g_uart.rx_ring, count - first);
610:     }
611: 
612:   g_uart.rx_read = (g_uart.rx_read + count) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
613:   if (status != NULL)
614:     {
615:       *status = g_uart.sticky_status;
616:       g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
617:     }
618: 
619:   if (!g_uart.upper_rts && g_uart.local_rts &&
620:       rx_count() < MB_UART_RTS_RELEASE)
621:     {
622:       update_local_rts();
623:     }
624: 
625:   up_irq_restore(flags);
626:   if (g_uart.initialized && count != 0)
627:     {
628:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
629:     }
630: 
631:   return count;
632: }

97: bk7258_start(void)
98: {

100:   uint8_t *dest;

102:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
103:    * floating-point extension.

106:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
107:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
108:   UP_DSB();
109:   UP_ISB();
110: 
111:   /* Match the current golden SPE SAU setup: the secure alias is retained,
112:    * while the 0x10000000 non-secure alias range is exposed as non-secure.
113:    */
114: 
115:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
116:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
117:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
118:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
119:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
120:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
121:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
122:   UP_DSB();
123:   UP_ISB();
124: 
125:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
126:     {
127:       *dest++ = *src++;
128:     }
129: 
130:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
131:     {
132:       *dest++ = 0;
133:     }
134: 
135:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
136:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
137:     {
138:       *dest++ = *src++;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
142:   UP_DSB();
143:   UP_ISB();

45:   while (total < length)

51:         {

53:         }

56:       if (ret <= 0)

59:         }

61:       total += ret;

1: #!/bin/sh
2: 
3: set -eu
4: 
5: script_dir=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
6: csv=${1:-$script_dir/../../../../external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv}
7: 
8: if [ ! -r "$csv" ]; then
9:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout: cannot read $csv" >&2
10:   exit 1
11: fi
12: 
13: result=$(awk -F, '
14:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
15:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
16:     value = tolower(value)
17:     result = 0
18:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
19:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
20:       if (digit < 0) return -1
21:       result = result * 16 + digit
22:     }
23:     return result
24:   }
25:   BEGIN { base = hex("28000000"); found = 0 }
26:   /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
27:   /^[[:space:]]*PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE/ { next }
28:   NF >= 4 {
29:     name = $1
30:     type = $2
31:     offset = $3
32:     size = $4
33:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", name)
34:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", type)
35:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", offset)
36:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", size)
37:     if (type != "SRAM") next
38:     if (offset != "") base = hex(offset)
39:     bytes = hex(size)
40:     if (name == "SWAP") {
41:       printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base, bytes
42:       found = 1
43:     }
44:     base += bytes
45:   }
46:   END { if (!found) exit 2 }
47: ' "$csv")
48: 
49: if [ "$result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
50:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout mismatch: $result" >&2
51:   exit 1
52: fi

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: #include <stdio.h>
9: 
10: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
11: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
12: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
13: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: 
16: #include "bk7258_psram.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
18: 
19: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
20: #define PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD 0x7u
21: #define PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD 0x8u
22: #define PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD 0x9u
23: #define PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD 0xau
24: #define PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1 11u
25: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON 0u
26: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF 1u
27: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT 0u
28: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH 1u
29: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
30: #define PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS 500u
31: #define PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS 1000u
32: 
33: struct pwc_message
34: {
35:   uint32_t header;
36:   uint32_t param1;
37:   uint32_t param2;
38:   uint32_t param3;
39: };
40: 
41: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
42: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
43: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
44: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
45: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
46: static sem_t g_psram_power_sem;
47: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
48: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
49: static volatile bool g_psram_power_waiting;
50: static volatile uint32_t g_psram_power_state;
51: 
52: static void psram_power_vote_rollback(void)
53: {
54:   int ret;
55: 
56:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
57:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
58:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF, 0);
59:   if (ret >= 0)
60:     {
61:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
62:     }
63: 
64:   if (ret < 0)
65:     {
66:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote rollback failed, error=%d\n", ret);
67:     }
68: }
69: 
70: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
71: {
72:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
73: 
74:   (void)argc;
75:   (void)argv;
76:   for (;;)
77:     {
78:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
79:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
80:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
81:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
82:     }
83:   return 0;
84: }
85: 
86: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
87: {
88:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
89:   struct pwc_message message;
90:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
91:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
92:     {
93:       return;
94:     }
95:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
96:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
97:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
98:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
99:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
100:   g_head = next;
101:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
102: }
103: 
104: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
105: {
106:   (void)argc;
107:   (void)argv;
108:   g_worker_ready = true;
109:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       struct pwc_message message;
113:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
114:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
115:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
116:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
117:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
118:         {
119:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
120:             /* The unmodified AVDK SMP firmware returns the requested ON/OFF
121:              * state in param1. It does not expose the PSRAM driver result or
122:              * detected capacity, so AP validates its configured regions with
123:              * the non-destructive boundary probe before creating allocators.
124:              */
125: 
126:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
127:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
128:               {
129:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
130:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
131:               }
132:             break;
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
135:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
136:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
137:               {
138:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
139:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
140:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
141:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
142:               }
143:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
144:               {
145:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
146: 
147:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
148:               }
149:             break;
150: 
151:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
152:             bk7258_psram_dump();
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
156:             {
157:               int ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
158: 
159:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
160:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
161:                 ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
162:                            PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
163:             }
164:             break;
165: #endif
166: 
167:           default:
168:             break;
169:         }
170:     }
171:   return 0;
172: }
173: 
174: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
175: {
176:   int pid;
177:   int ret;
178: 
179:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
180:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
181:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
182:   g_head = 0;
183:   g_tail = 0;
184:   g_worker_ready = false;
185:   g_ready_sent = false;
186:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
187:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
188:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
189:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
190:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
191:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
192:     {
193:       return -1;
194:     }
195: 
196:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
197:   if (ret < 0)
198:     {
199:       printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
200:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
201:       return ret;
202:     }
203:   printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport complete\n");
204: 
205:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
206:                      NULL) < 0)
207:     {
208:       return -1;
209:     }
210:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
211:   if (pid < 0)
212:     {
213:       return pid;
214:     }
215:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
216:       !g_worker_ready)
217:     {
218:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
219:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
220:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
221:     }
222:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
223: 
224:   /* CP boots CPU1 from its low-power worker and waits there for this ready
225:    * command. Send it before requesting PSRAM, whose vote is handled by that
226:    * same worker, otherwise the two cores deadlock waiting for each other.
227:    */
228: 
229:   g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD,
230:                                          1, 0, 0) == 0;
231:   if (!g_ready_sent)
232:     {
233:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready queue failed\n");
234:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
235:       return -EIO;
236:     }
237: 
238:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
239:   if (ret < 0)
240:     {
241:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
242:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
243:       return ret;
244:     }
245: 
246:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
247: 
248: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
249:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;
250:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
251:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
252:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON, 0);
253:   if (ret >= 0)
254:     {
255:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_psram_power_sem,
256:                          MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
257:     }
258: 
259:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
260:   if (ret < 0 || g_psram_power_state != PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
261:     {
262:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power response failed, error=%d state=%lu\n",
263:              ret, (unsigned long)g_psram_power_state);
264:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
265:       psram_power_vote_rollback();
266: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
267:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EIO;
268: #endif
269:     }
270:   else
271:     {
272:       /* printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote ON acknowledged\n"); */
273:       ret = bk7258_psram_initialize();
274:       if (ret < 0)
275:         {
276:           printf("PWC: PSRAM allocator initialization failed, error=%d\n",
277:                  ret);
278:           psram_power_vote_rollback();
279: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
280:           return ret;
281: #endif
282:         }
283:       else
284:         {
285:           /* printf("PWC: PSRAM allocators ONLINE\n"); */
286:         }
287:     }
288: #endif
289: 
290:   if (g_ready_sent)
291:     {
292:       return 0;
293:     }
294: 
295:   return -1;
296: }

5: #define MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX	0x02
6: #define MBOX0_CTRL_RESET		0x04

8: #define MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM	4
9: 
10: typedef struct
11: {
12: 	mailbox_data_t cmd[MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM];
13: 	mailbox_data_t ack[MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM];
14: 	mailbox_data_t reset;

16: 	u8 cmd_used[MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM];
17: 	u8 cmd_active;
18: 	u8 ack_used[MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM];
19: 	u8 reset_used;
20: 	u8 sync_used;
21: 	u32 publish_order;
22: 	u32 cmd_order[MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM];
23: 	u32 ack_order[MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM];
24: 	u32 reset_order;
25: 	u32 sync_order;
26: } mbox0_tx_slots_t;

28: static __attribute__((aligned(32))) mbox0_tx_slots_t mailbox_slots[MBOX_CHNL_NUM];
29: static mailbox_callback_t  mailbox_callback[MBOX_CHNL_NUM] = {0};

31: static mailbox_data_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl, u8 *kind, u8 *index)
32: {
33: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
34: 	u8 i;
35: 
36: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_RESET)
37: 	{
38: 		if (slots->reset_used)
39: 			return NULL;
40: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
41: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
42: 		*kind = 2;
43: 		return &slots->reset;
44: 	}
45: 
46: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
47: 	{
48: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
49: 		{
50: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
51: 			{
52: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
53: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
54: 				*kind = 1;
55: 				*index = i;
56: 				return &slots->ack[i];
57: 			}
58: 		}
59: 		return NULL;
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
63: 	{
64: 		if (slots->sync_used)
65: 			return NULL;
66: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
67: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
68: 		*kind = 3;
69: 		return &slots->sync;
70: 	}
71: 
72: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
73: 	{
74: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
75: 		{
76: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
77: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
78: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
79: 			*kind = 0;
80: 			*index = i;
81: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
82: 		}
83: 	}
84: 
85: 	return NULL;
86: }

88: static void mbox0_release_slot(u8 dst, u8 kind, u8 index)
89: {
90: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
91: 
92: 	if (kind == 0)
93: 	{
94: 		slots->cmd_used[index] = 0;
95: 		if (slots->cmd_active == index + 1)
96: 			slots->cmd_active = 0;
97: 	}
98: 	else if (kind == 1)
99: 	{
100: 		slots->ack_used[index] = 0;
101: 	}
102: 	else if (kind == 2)
103: 	{
104: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
105: 	}
106: 	else
107: 	{
108: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
109: 	}

112: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
113: {
114: 	mailbox_data_t data;
115: 	u32 chnl = msg->src_cpu;
116: 
117: 	if(chnl >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
118: 		return;
119: 
120: 	if(msg->data[1] == sizeof(data))
121: 	{
122: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
123: 	  	extern void flush_dcache(void *va, long size);
124: 		flush_dcache((void *)msg->data[0], sizeof(data));
125: #endif
126: 		memcpy(&data, (u8 *)msg->data[0], sizeof(data));
127: 	}
128: 	else
129: 	{
130: 		return;
131: 	}
132: 
133: 	if(mailbox_callback[chnl] != NULL)
134: 		mailbox_callback[chnl](&data);
135: }

137: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_init(void)
138: {

141: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_init();
142: 	if(ret_code != 0)
143: 		return BK_FAIL;

151: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_deinit(void)
152: {
153: 	int ret_code;
154: 
155: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_deinit();
156: 	if(ret_code != 0)
157: 		return BK_FAIL;
158: 
159: 	return BK_OK;

165: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
166: 
167: 	return BK_OK;
168: 
169: }

171: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
172: {
173: 	mbox0_message_t message;
174: 	mailbox_data_t *slot;
175: 	u8 ctrl = 0;
176: 	u8 kind = 0;
177: 	u8 index = 0;
178: 
179: 	if(dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
180: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
181: 
182: 	if(data == NULL)
183: 	{
184: 		return BK_FAIL;
185: 	}
186: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
187: 
188: 	(void)src;
189: 	(void)arg;
190: 	
191: 	uint32_t fifo_status = 0;
192: 
193: 	int ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat((uint32_t)dst, &fifo_status);
194: 
195: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
196: 	{
197: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
198: 	}
199: 
200: 	if(RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL & fifo_status)
201: 	{
202: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;  // mailbox busy
203: 	}
204: 
205: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
206: 	if (slot == NULL)
207: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
208: 
209: 	memcpy(slot, data, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
210: 
211: 	message.data[0] = (u32)slot;
212: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
213: 	message.dest_cpu = (uint8_t)dst;
214: 
215: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
216: 
217: 	if(ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
218: 	{
219: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
220: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
221: 	}
222: 
223: 	return BK_OK;
224: }
225: 
226: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
227: {
228: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
229: 	u32 completed_order;
230: 	u8 i;
231: 
232: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
233: 		return;
234: 
235: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
236: 	if (slots->cmd_active == 0)
237: 		return;
238: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
239: 
240: 	/* A matching command ACK proves only envelopes published before that
241: 	 * command were copied. ACKs sent after it wait for the STATE probe. */
242: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
243: 	{
244: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
245: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
246: 	}
247: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
248: 	{
249: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
250: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
251: 	}
252: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
253: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
254: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
255: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
256: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
257: }
258: 
259: void bk_mailbox_tx_timeout(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
260: {
261: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
262: 		return;
263: 
264: 	/* Keep the active command slot quarantined. A later matching probe ACK
265: 	 * releases it through bk_mailbox_tx_complete(). */
266: 	mailbox_slots[dst].cmd_active = 0;
267: }

269: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, mailbox_callback_t callback)
270: {
271: 	if(src >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
272: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
273: 
274: 	mailbox_callback[src] = callback;
275: 	
276: 	return BK_OK;
277: }
278: 
279: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_recv_callback_unregister(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
280: {
281: 	if(src >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
282: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
283: 
284: 	mailbox_callback[src] = NULL;
285: 
286: 	return BK_OK;
287: }

244: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
245: {
246: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
247: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
248: 	u16 			chnl_type;
249: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
250: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
251: 
252: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
253: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
254: 
255: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
256: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
257: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
258: 		return 4;
259: #endif
260: 
261: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
262: 		return 5;
263: 
264: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
265: 		return 3;
266: 
267: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
268: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
269: 
270: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
271: 		return 1;
272: 
273: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
274: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
275: 
276: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
277: 
278: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
279: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
280: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
281: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
282: 
283: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
286: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
287: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
288: 
289: 	__DMB();
290: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
291: 
292: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
293: 
294: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
295: 
296: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
297: 	{
298: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
299: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
300: 
301: 		return 2;
302: 	}
303: 
304: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
305: 
306: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 
308: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
309: 	{
310: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
311: 	}
312: 
313: 	return 0;
314: }
