316: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
317: {
318: 	u8		log_chnl;
319: 	u8		ret_code;
320: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
321: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
322: 
323: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
324: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
325: 
326: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
327: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
328: 	{
329: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
330: 
331: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
332: 		if (GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
333: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
334: 		{
335: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
336: 			return;
337: 		}
338: 
339: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
340: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
341: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
342: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
343: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
344: 		BK_LOGW("mb_chnl", "peer reset cpu=%u active=%x/%u/%u\r\n",
345: 			phy_chnl_idx, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl,
346: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd);
347: 
348: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
349: 		{
350: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
351: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
352: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
353: 			{
354: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
355: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
356: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
357: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
358: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
359: 			}
360: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
361: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
362: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
363: 		}
364: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
365: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
366: 		return;
367: 	}
368: 
369: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
370: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
371: 
372: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
373: 
374: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
375: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
376: 		return;
377: 	}
378: 
379: 
380: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
381: 	{
382: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
383: 		return;
384: 	}
385: 
386: 
387: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
388: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
389: 		return;
390: 	}
391: 
392: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
393: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
394: 
395: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
396: 	{
397: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
398: 		return;
399: 	}
400: 
401: 	if ((ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
402: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
403: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
404: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
405: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
406: 	{
407: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
408: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
409: 
410: 		BK_LOGW("mb_chnl", "stale ack ch=%x seq=%u cmd=%u active=%x/%u/%u\r\n",
411: 			log_chnl, ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq, ack_ptr->hdr.cmd,
412: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq,
413: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd);
414: 		return;
415: 	}
416: 
417: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
418: 
419: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		/* clear following header members. */
422: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
423: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
424: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
425: 
426: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
427: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
428: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
429: 	} else {
430: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
434: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
435: 	{
436: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
437: 			break;
438: 	}
439: 
440: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
441: 	{
442: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
443: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
444: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
445: 		return;
446: 	}
447: 
448: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
449: 
450: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
451: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
452: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
453: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
454: 
455: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
456: 
457: 	if(ret_code != 0)
458: 	{
459: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
460: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
461: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
462: 	}
463: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
464: 
465: 	return;
466: 
467: }

469: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
470: {
471: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
472: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
473: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
474: 	u16 		chnl_type;
475: 
476: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
477: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
478: 
479: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
480: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
481: 
482: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
483: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
484: 
485: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
486: 
487: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
488: 		return;
489: 
490: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
491: 		return;
492: 
493: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
494: 		return;
495: 
496: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
497: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
498: 
499: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
500: 
501: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
502: 	{
503: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
504: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
505: 
506: 		return;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
510: 	{
511: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
512: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
513: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
514: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
515: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
516: 
517: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
518: 
519: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
520: 	}
521: 	else
522: 	{
523: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
524: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
525: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
529: 	{
530: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
531: 		return;
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
535: 
536: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
537: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
538: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
539: 
540: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
541: 
542: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
543: 
544: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
545: 
546: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
547: 	{
548: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
549: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
550: 
551: 		return;
552: 	}
553: 
554: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
555: 	mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
556: 		       MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
557: 	return;
558: }

560: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
561: {
562: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
563: 
564: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
565: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
566: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
567: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
568: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
569: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
570: 
571: 	/*
572: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
573: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
574: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
575: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
576: 	 */
577: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
578: 	{
579: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
580: 	}
581: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
582: 	{
583: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
584: 	}
585: }

587: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
588: {
589: 	u8		ret_code;
590: 
591: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
592: 
593: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
594: 
595: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
596: 
597: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
598: 		return;
599: 
600: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
601: 		return;
602: 
603: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
604: 
605: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
606: 	{
607: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
608: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
609: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
610: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
611: 
612: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
613: 
614: 		if(ret_code != 0)
615: 		{
616: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
617: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
618: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
619: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
620: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
621: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
622: 
623: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
624: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
625: 			}
626: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
627: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
628: 		}
629: 	}
630: 
631: 	return;
632: }

634: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
635: 
636: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
637: {
638: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
639: 	u16 			chnl_type;
640: 
641: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
642: 
643: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
644: 
645: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
646: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
647: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
648: #endif
649: 
650: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
651: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
652: 
653: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
654: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
655: 
656: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
657: 
658: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
659: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
660: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
661: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
662: 
663: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
664: 
665: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
666: 	
667: 	/*
668: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
669: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
670: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
671: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
672: 	 */
673: 	while(1)
674: 	{
675: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
676: 
677: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
678: 		{
679: 			break;
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 
683: 	return ret_code;
684: }

687: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
688: /*
689:   * init logical chnanel module.
690:   * return:
691:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
692:   *     failed  : fail code.
693:   *
694:   */
695: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
696: {
697: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
698: 	int				i, j;
699: 
700: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
701: 
702: 	/*
703: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
704: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
705: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
706: 	 * can race here:
707: 	 *
708: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
709: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
710: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
711: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
712: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
713: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
714: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
715: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
716: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
717: 	 *
718: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
719: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
720: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
721: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
722: 	 */
723: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
724: 	{
725: 		return BK_OK;
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
729: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
730: 	{
731: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
732: 		return BK_OK;
733: 	}
734: 
735: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
736: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
737: 	{
738: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
739: 
740: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
741: 
742: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
743: 
744: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
745: 		{
746: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
747: 		}
748: 	}
749: 
750: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
751: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
752: 	{
753: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
754: 		return ret_code;
755: 	}
756: 
757: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
758: 
759: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
760: 	{
761: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
762: 
763: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
767: 
768: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
769: 
770: 	return BK_OK;
771: }

909: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;

911: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
912: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;

924: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)

926: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
927: 
928: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
929: 	}
930: 
931: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
932: 
933: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,

938: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */

213: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
214: {
215: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
216: 
217: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
218: 
219: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
220: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
221: 
222: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
223: 	{
224: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
225: 	}
226: 	else
227: 	{
228: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
229: 	}
230: 
231: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
232: 	{
233: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
234: 		tx_fail = 1;
235: 		BK_LOGW(MOD_TAG, "bad DATA ptr=%p expected=%p len=%u flags=%x crc=%x rsv=%x\r\n",
236: 			uart_cmd->cmd_buff, chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff,
237: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len, uart_cmd->resvd,
238: 			uart_cmd->crc8, uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
239: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
243: 	{
244: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		
247: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
251: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
252: 	#endif
253: 
254: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
255: 
256: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
257: 
258: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
259: 	{
260: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
261: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
262: 	}
263: 	else
264: 	{
265: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
266: 
267: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
268: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
269: 
270: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
271: 		{
272: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
273: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
274: 		}
275: 		else
276: 		{
277: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
278: 
279: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
280: 			{
281: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
282: 			}
283: 
284: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
285: 		}
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
289: 
290: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
291: 	{
292: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
293: 	}
294: 
295: rx_isr_data_xit:
296: 	
297: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
303: 
304: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
305: 
306: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
307: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
308: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
309: 	 */
310: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
311: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
312: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
313: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
314: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
315: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
316: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
317: 
318: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
319: 	{
320: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
321: 		{
322: 			/* trigger send! */
323: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
324: 		}
325: 	}
326: 	
327: 	return;
328: }

330: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
331: {
332: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
333: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
334: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
335: 
336: 	if (!invalid)
337: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
338: 	else
339: 	{
340: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
341: 		BK_LOGW(MOD_TAG, "bad STATE payload=%p len=%u flags=%x crc=%x rsv=%x\r\n",
342: 			uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len,
343: 			uart_cmd->resvd, uart_cmd->crc8, uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
344: 	}
345: 
346: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
347: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
348: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
349: 	 */
350: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
351: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
352: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
353: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
354: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
355: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
356: 
357: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
358: 	{
359: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
360: 		{
361: 			/* trigger send! */
362: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
363: 		}
364: 	}
365: 
366: 	return;
367: }

369: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
370: {
371: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
372: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
373: 	
374: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
375: 	{
376: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
377: 	}
378: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
379: 	{
380: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
381: 	}
382: 	else
383: 	{
384: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
385: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
386: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
387: 		 */
388: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
389: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
390: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
391: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
392: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
393: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
394: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
395: 	}
396: 	
397: 	return;
398: }

400: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
401: {
402: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
403: 
404: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
405: 
406: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
407: 
408: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
409: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
410: 	{
411: 		/*
412: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
413: 		 */
414: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
415: 
416: 		return;
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
420: 
421: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
422: 	{
423: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
424: 	}
425: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
426: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 1;
429: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
430: 	}
431: 	else
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
437: 	{
438: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
439: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
440: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
441: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
444: 	{
445: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
446: 		{
447: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
448: 			BK_LOGI(MOD_TAG, "link ready ch=%x cts=%u\r\n",
449: 				chnl_cb->chnl_id, chnl_cb->status_cts);
450: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
451: 		}
452: 	}
453: 
454: 	if (tx_fail)
455: 	{
456: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
457: 		{
458: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
459: 			{
460: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
461: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
462: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
463: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
464: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
465: 			}
466: 			else
467: 			{
468: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
469: 			}
470: 		}
471: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
472: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
473: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
474: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
475: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "TX fail cmd=%u state=%x remote=%u\r\n",
476: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.state, uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail);
477: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
478: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
479: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
480: 		return;
481: 	}
482: 
483: 	/* try next Tx. */
484: 
485: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
486: 
487: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
488: 	{
489: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
490: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
491: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
492: 	}
493: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
494: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
495: 
496: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
497: 	{
498: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
502: 	{
503: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	return;
507: }

509: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
510: {
511: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
512: 	{
513: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
514: 	}
515: 	else
516: 	{
517: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
518: 		{
519: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
520: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
521: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
522: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
523: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
524: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
525: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
526: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
527: 		}
528: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
529: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
530: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
531: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
532: 		else
533: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
534: 	}
535: 
536: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
537: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
538: }

595: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
596: {
597: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
598: 
599: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
600: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
601: 
602: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
603: 	{
604: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
608: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
609: 
610: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
611: 	{
612: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
613: 	}
614: 	else
615: 	{
616: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
617: 	}
618: 
619: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
620: 	{
621: 		return BK_FAIL;
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
625: 	{
626: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
627: 	}
628: 
629: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
630: 	{
631: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
632: 	}
633: 	else
634: 	{
635: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
636: 
637: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
638: 		{
639: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
640: 		}
641: 		else
642: 		{
643: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
644: 
645: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
646: 		}
647: 	}
648: 
649: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
650: 
651: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
652: 
653: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
654: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
655: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
656: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
657: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
658: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
659: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
660: 
661: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
662: 
663: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
664: 	{
665: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
666: 	}
667: 
668: 	return ret_val;
669: }

671: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
672: {
673: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
674: 
675: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
676: 	{
677: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
678: 		return BK_OK;
679: 	}
680: 
681: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
682: 
683: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
684: 
685: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
686: 
687: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
688: 
689: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
690: 	{
691: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
692: 	}
693: 
694: 	return ret_val;
695: }

697: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
698: {
699: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
700: 
701: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
702: 
703: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
704: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
705: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = NULL;
706: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = 0;
707: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
708: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
709: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = 0;
710: 
711: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
712: 
713: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);

715: 	return ret_val;

718: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
719: {
720: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
721: 
722: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
723: 	{
724: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;

726: 		return BK_OK;
727: 	}

729: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
730: 
731: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
732: 
733: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
734: 
735: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
736: 
737: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
738: 	{
739: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
740: 	}
741: 
742: 	return ret_val;
743: }

745: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
746: {
747: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
748: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
749: 	
750: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
751: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
752: 
753: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
754: 	{
755: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
756: 	}
757: 	else
758: 	{
759: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
760: 	}
761: 
762: 	wr_len = data_len;
763: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
764: 		wr_len = rem_len;
765: 
766: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
767: 	{
768: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
769: 	}
770: 	else
771: 	{
772: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
773: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
774: 
775: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
776: 		{
777: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
778: 		}
779: 		else
780: 		{
781: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
782: 
783: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
784: 		}
785: 	}
786: 
787: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
788: 
789: 	/* trigger send! */
790: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
791: 
792: 	return wr_len;
793: }

795: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
796: {
797: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
798: 
799: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
800: 		return 0;
801: 
802: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
803: 
804: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
805: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
806: 
807: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
808: 	{
809: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
810: 	}
811: 	else
812: 	{
813: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
817: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
818: 		rd_len = buf_len;
819: 
820: 	if(rd_len == 0)
821: 	{
822: 		return 0;
823: 	}
824: 
825: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
826: 	{
827: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
828: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
829: 	}
830: 	else
831: 	{
832: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
833: 
834: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
835: 		{
836: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
837: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
838: 		}
839: 		else
840: 		{
841: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
842: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
843: 			{
844: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
845: 			}
846: 
847: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
848: 		}
849: 	}
850: 
851: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
852: 
853: 	/* rts assert...... */
854: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
855: 	{
856: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
857: 		{
858: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
859: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
860: 		}
861: 	}
862: 
863: 	return rd_len;
864: 
865: }

111: static void ap_bridge_log_output(const u8 *line, u16 length)

118: 	memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
119: 	memcpy(output + sizeof(prefix) - 1, line, length);
120: 	output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1 + length;
121: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
122: 	{

124: 			return;

137: static void ap_bridge_drain_tx(void)
138: {
139: 	u8 data[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
140: 	u16 count;
141: 	u16 length;
142: 	u16 written;
143: 	u16 i;
144: 	u32 flags;
145: 
146: 	while (s_ap_bridge.link_ready && (count = ap_bridge_tx_count()) != 0)
147: 	{
148: 		length = MIN(count, (u16)sizeof(data));
149: 		length = MIN(length, bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0));
150: 		if (!length)
151: 			break;
152: 
153: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
154: 		for (i = 0; i < length; i++)
155: 			data[i] = s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[(s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + i) %
156: 							 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring)];
157: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
158: 
159: 		written = bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, data, length);
160: 		if (!written)
161: 			break;
162: 		if (written < length)
163: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_partial++;
164: 
165: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
166: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
167: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
168: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
169: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
170: 	}
171: }

173: static void ap_bridge_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
174: {
175: 	u8 input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
176: 	u8 line[AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
177: 	u16 line_length = 0;
178: 	u8 active_mode = AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG;
179: 
180: 	(void)arg;
181: 	for (;;)
182: 	{
183: 		u32 events;
184: 		u32 flags;
185: 		u16 input_length;
186: 		u16 index;
187: 		bk_err_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem,
188: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);
189: 
190: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
191: 		events = s_ap_bridge.events;
192: 		s_ap_bridge.events = 0;
193: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
194: 
195: 		bk_mb_uart_poll(MB_UART0);
196: 		if ((events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_READY) ||
197: 			bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
198: 			s_ap_bridge.link_ready = 1;
199: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
200: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
201: 			s_ap_bridge.link_ready = 0;
202: 
203: 		if (active_mode != s_ap_bridge.output_mode)
204: 		{
205: 			if (line_length)
206: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length);
207: 			line_length = 0;
208: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.output_mode;
209: 			BK_LOGI(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "output mode=%s\r\n",
210: 				active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW ? "RAW" : "LOG");
211: 		}
212: 
213: 		do
214: 		{
215: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
216: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
217: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
218: 			{
219: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
220: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
221: 				continue;
222: 			}
223: 
224: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
225: 			{
226: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
227: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
228: 				{
229: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length);
230: 					line_length = 0;
231: 				}
232: 			}
233: 		} while (input_length != 0);
234: 
235: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
236: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
237: 		{
238: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length);
239: 			line_length = 0;
240: 		}
241: 
242: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
243: 
244: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
245: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
246: 		{
247: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
248: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
249: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
250: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
251: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
252: 			BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "link down event=%x queued=%u\r\n",
253: 				events, ap_bridge_tx_count());
254: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: }

268: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread,
269: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
270: 					 "ap_console", ap_bridge_task, 3072, NULL);
271: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
272: 	{
273: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);

282: 		return ret;

304: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
305: {
306: 	u16 written = 0;
307: 	u32 flags;
308: 
309: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
310: 		return 0;
311: 
312: 	flags = rtos_disable_int();
313: 	while (written < length)
314: 	{
315: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
316: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
317: 			break;
318: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
319: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
320: 	}
321: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
322: 	if (written < length)
323: 	{
324: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
325: 		if (s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop == (u32)(length - written) ||
326: 			!(s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop & 0xff))
327: 			BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "TX overflow drop=%u total=%u\r\n",
328: 				length - written, (unsigned)s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop);
329: 	}
330: 	if (written)
331: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
332: 	return written;
333: }

521: static u8 * alloc_log_blk(u16 log_len, u16 *blk_tag)
522: {
523: 	u16    free_blk_id;
524: 	u8     queue_id;
525: 	u8     ovf_cnt_saved = 0;
526: 	free_queue_t * free_q;
527: 	u8     *       blk_buf = NULL;
528: 
529: 	u32  int_mask = shell_task_enter_critical();
530: 
531: 	for(queue_id = 0; queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue); queue_id++)
532: 	{
533: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
534: 
535: 		/*    queue ascending in blk_len.    */
536: 		if(free_q->blk_len < log_len)
537: 			continue;
538: 
539: 		if(free_q->free_blk_num > 0)
540: 		{
541: 			free_blk_id = free_q->blk_list[free_q->list_out_idx];
542: 
543: 			// free_q->list_out_idx = (free_q->list_out_idx + 1) % free_q->blk_num;
544: 			if((free_q->list_out_idx + 1) < free_q->blk_num)
545: 				free_q->list_out_idx++;
546: 			else
547: 				free_q->list_out_idx = 0;
548: 
549: 			free_q->free_blk_num--;
550: 
551: 			blk_buf = &free_q->log_buf[free_blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
552: 			*blk_tag = MAKE_BLOCK_TAG(free_blk_id, queue_id);
553: 
554: 			break;
555: 		}
556: 		else
557: 		{
558: 			if(ovf_cnt_saved == 0)
559: 			{
560: 				free_q->ovf_cnt++;
561: 				ovf_cnt_saved = 1;
562: 			}
563: 		}
564: 	}
565: 
566: 	if(blk_buf == NULL)
567: 	{
568: 		shell_log_overflow++;
569: 	}
570: 	else
571: 	{
572: 		fault_hint_print = 0;
573: 		shell_log_count++;
574: 	}
575: 
576: 	shell_task_exit_critical(int_mask);
577: 
578: 	return blk_buf;
579: }

581: static bool_t free_log_blk(u16 block_tag)
582: {
583: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(block_tag);
584: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(block_tag);
585: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
586: 
587: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
588: 		return bFALSE;
589: 
590: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
591: 
592: 	if(blk_id >= free_q->blk_num)
593: 		return bFALSE;
594: 
595: 	//disable_interrupt(); // called from tx-complete only, don't lock interrupt.
596: 
597: 	free_q->blk_list[free_q->list_in_idx] = blk_id;
598: 
599: 	//free_q->list_in_idx = (free_q->list_in_idx + 1) % free_q->blk_num;
600: 	if((free_q->list_in_idx + 1) < free_q->blk_num)
601: 		free_q->list_in_idx++;
602: 	else
603: 		free_q->list_in_idx = 0;
604: 
605: 	free_q->free_blk_num++;
606: 
607: 	//enable_interrupt(); // called from tx-complete only, don't lock interrupt.
608: 
609: 	return bTRUE;
610: }

612: static int merge_log_data(u16 blk_tag, u16 data_len)
613: {
614: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
615: 	{
616: 		return 0;
617: 	}
618: 
619: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(blk_tag);
620: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(blk_tag);
621: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
622: 	{
623: 		return 0;
624: 	}
625: 
626: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
627: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
628: 
629: 	u8		* src_buf = NULL;
630: 
631: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
632: 	{
633: 		src_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
634: 	}
635: 	else
636: 		return 0;
637: 
638: 	u16    pre_in_idx;
639: 
640: 	if(pending_queue.list_in_idx > 0)
641: 		pre_in_idx = pending_queue.list_in_idx - 1;
642: 	else
643: 		pre_in_idx = SHELL_LOG_PEND_NUM - 1;
644: 
645: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
646: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
647: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
648: 	{
649: 		return 0;
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	u8		* dst_buf = NULL;
653: 	u16       buf_len = 0;
654: 
655: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
656: 
657: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
658: 	{
659: 		dst_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
660: 		buf_len = free_q->blk_len;
661: 	}
662: 	else
663: 		return 0;
664: 
665: 	u16       cur_len = pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len;
666: 
667: 	if((cur_len + data_len) > buf_len)  /* can be merged into one buffer? */
668: 		return 0;
669: 
670: 	memcpy(dst_buf + cur_len, src_buf, data_len);
671: 
672: 	pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len += data_len;
673: 
674: 	free_log_blk(blk_tag);  /* merged, free the log buffer. */
675: 
676: 	return 1;
677: }

718: /* call from cmd TX ISR. */
719: static int cmd_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
720: {
721: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
722: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
723: 
724: 	/* rsp ok ?? */
725: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID )    /* rsp. */
726: 	{
727: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
728: 
729: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
730: 		{
731: 			/* something wrong!!! */
732: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: in rsp.\r\n");
733: 		}
734: 
735: 		/* rsp compelete, rsp_buff can be used for next cmd/response. */
736: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.rsp_buf_semaphore);
737: 
738: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
739: 		if (s_uart0_owner == UART0_OWNER_TO_AP_PENDING)
740: 			set_shell_event(&shell_task_event, SHELL_EVENT_AP_SWITCH);
741: #endif
742: 
743: 		return 1;
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID )    /* cmd_ind. */
747: 	{
748: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
749: 
750: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
751: 		{
752: 			/* something wrong!!! */
753: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: indication.\r\n");
754: 		}
755: 
756: 		/* indication tx compelete, cmd_ind_buff can be used for next cmd_indication. */
757: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.ind_buf_semaphore);
758: 
759: 		return 1;
760: 	}
761: 
762: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
763: 	{
764: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
765: 
766: 		if (blk_id == 1)
767: 		{
768: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str)
769: 			{
770: 				/* something wrong!!! */
771: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
772: 			}
773: 
774: 			cmd_line_buf.cmd_ovf_hint = 0;
775: 
776: 			return 1;
777: 		}
778: 	}
779: 
780: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID )    /* slave buffer. */
781: 	{
782: 		#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
783: 		if (log_handle_init_ok) {
784: 			set_fwd_state(blk_id);
785: 		} else {
786: 			result_fwd(blk_id);
787: 		}
788: 		return 1;
789: 		#endif
790: 	}
791: 
792: 	return 0;
793: }

809: /* call from log TX ISR. */
810: static int log_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
811: {
812: 	u16     block_tag;
813: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
814: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
815: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
816: 
817: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
818: 	{
819: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
820: 
821: 		if (blk_id == 0)
822: 		{
823: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_fault_str)
824: 			{
825: 				/* something wrong!!! */
826: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
827: 			}
828: 
829: 			return 1;
830: 		}
831: 	}
832: 
833: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))   /* from log busy queue. */
834: 	{
835: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
836: 
837: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
838: 
839: 		block_tag = log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_out_idx];
840: 
841: 		if( ( buf_tag != block_tag ) || (blk_id >= free_q->blk_num) ||
842: 			( (&free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len]) != pbuf) )
843: 		{
844: 			/* something wrong!!! */
845: 			/*        FAULT !!!!      */
846: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:%x,%x\r\n", buf_tag, block_tag);
847: 
848: 			return -1;
849: 		}
850: 
851: 		/* de-queue from busy queue. */
852: 		//log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
853: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
854: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx++;
855: 		else
856: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = 0;
857: 
858: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt++;
859: 
860: 		/* free buffer to queue. */
861: 		free_log_blk(block_tag);
862: 
863: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL) {
864: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&log_buf_semaphore);
865: 		}
866: 
867: 		return 1;
868: 	}
869: 
870: 	if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) {
871: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_pop_front();
872: 		free_list_push_front(node);
873: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL)
874: 			set_shell_event(&shell_log_event, SHELL_EVENT_DYM_FREE);
875: 		return 1;
876: 	}
877: 	return 0;
878: }

1052: /* call this in interrupt !* DISABLED *! context. */
1053: static void tx_req_process(void)
1054: {
1055: 	u8		*packet_buf = NULL;
1056: 	u16		block_tag;
1057: 	u16		log_len;
1058: 	u16		tx_ready;
1059: 	u16		blk_id;
1060: 	u8		queue_id;
1061: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
1062: 
1063: 	/* maybe tx_req is from tx_complete_callback, check if there any log in queue. */
1064: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
1065: 		return;
1066: 
1067: 	if(log_busy_queue.free_cnt == 0)
1068: 		return;
1069: 	
1070: 	tx_ready = 0;
1071: 
1072: 	log_dev->dev_drv->io_ctrl(log_dev, SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_STATUS, &tx_ready);
1073: 
1074: 	if(tx_ready == 0)
1075: 		return;
1076: 
1077: 	/**    ====     POP from pending queue     ====    **/
1078: 	pull_pending_queue(&block_tag, &log_len);
1079: 
1080: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(block_tag);
1081: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(block_tag);
1082: 
1083: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1084: 	{
1085: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
1086: 
1087: 		if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
1088: 		{
1089: 			packet_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
1090: 		}
1091: 	}
1092: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID)
1093: 	{
1094: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff;
1095: 
1096: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1097: 		{
1098: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1099: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1100: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1101: 			 * rsp will not be pushed into pending queue.
1102: 			 */
1103: 		}
1104: 	}
1105: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID)
1106: 	{
1107: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff;
1108: 
1109: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1110: 		{
1111: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1112: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1113: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1114: 			 * indication will not be pushed into pending queue.
1115: 			 */
1116: 		}
1117: 	}
1118: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID)
1119: 	{
1120: 		if(blk_id == 0)
1121: 		{
1122: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)shell_fault_str;
1123: 		}
1124: 		else if(blk_id == 1)
1125: 		{
1126: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str;
1127: 			if(log_dev != cmd_dev)
1128: 			{
1129: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1130: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1131: 				/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1132: 				 * cmd_hint will not be pushed into pending queue.
1133: 				 */
1134: 			}
1135: 		}
1136: 		else
1137: 		{
1138: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1139: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1140: 		}
1141: 	}
1142: 	else if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) 
1143: 	{
1144: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_switch();
1145: 		packet_buf = node->ptr;
1146: 	}
1147: 	#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
1148: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID)
1149: 	{
1150: 		if(blk_id == MBOX_RSP_BLK_ID)
1151: 		{
1152: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)ipc_fwd_data.rsp_buf.buf;
1153: 		}
1154: 		else if(blk_id == MBOX_IND_BLK_ID)
1155: 		{
1156: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)ipc_fwd_data.ind_buf.buf;
1157: 			if(log_dev != cmd_dev)
1158: 			{
1159: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1160: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1161: 				/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1162: 				 * fwd_data will not be pushed into pending queue.
1163: 				 */
1164: 			}
1165: 		}
1166: 		else
1167: 		{
1168: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1169: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1170: 		}
1171: 	}
1172: 	#endif
1173: 	else
1174: 	{
1175: 		/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1176: 		shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req %x.\r\n", block_tag);
1177: 	}
1178: 
1179: 	if(packet_buf == NULL)
1180: 		return;
1181: 
1182: 	/* rom & rsp buff not enter busy-queue. */
1183: 	if(queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1184: 	{
1185: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt--;
1186: 		log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_in_idx] = block_tag;
1187: 		//log_busy_queue.list_in_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_in_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
1188: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_in_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
1189: 			log_busy_queue.list_in_idx++;
1190: 		else
1191: 			log_busy_queue.list_in_idx = 0;
1192: 	}
1193: 
1194: 	log_dev->dev_drv->write_async(log_dev, packet_buf, log_len, block_tag); /* send to log dev driver. */
1195: 	/* if driver return 0, should free log-block or not de-queue pending queue and try again. */
1196: 	/* if return 1, push log-block into busy queue is OK. */
1197: 
1198: 	return;
1199: }

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
14: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
15: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
16: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |
17: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | MB_UART0 唯一 owner、LOG/RAW RX、1024 B TX ring 和 worker |
18: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | 完整 ACK 匹配、timeout/reset、probe 和诊断 |
19: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | 严格 DATA/STATE 校验、ACK 后推进和 link event |
20: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | command/ACK/reset/sync 分离稳定 slot |
21: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | 稳定 slot 完成和 quarantine 接口 |
22: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
23: 
24: UART0 bridge 保持 `MB_UART0` 唯一初始化 owner。AP 输出 LOG 模式保留 `ap0:`
25: 前缀、50 ms 半行刷新和有限重试；RAW 模式不改写字节。PC 到 AP 输入使用
26: 1024 B 有界 ring 和部分写 worker，所有物理 UART0 输出仍经 shell queue 串行化。
27: 
28: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
29: 七区域布局：
30: 
31: ```text
32: 0x60000000..0x60700000  四个媒体 slab，共 7 MiB
33: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
34: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
35: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
36: ```
37: 
38: ## 2. 同步到 SMP 工作树
39: 
40: 从工作区根目录执行：
41: 
42: ```bash
43: mirror=contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp
44: for path in \
45:   cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c \
46:   cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c \
47:   cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h \
48:   cp/include/components/shell_task.h \
49:   cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h \
50:   cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h \
51:   cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c \
52:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c \
53:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c \
54:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c \
55:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h \
56:   projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
57: do
58:   cp "$mirror/$path" "bk_avdk_smp/$path"
59: done
60: ```
61: 
62: 同步后必须逐字节检查：
63: 
64: ```bash
65: for path in \
66:   cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c \
67:   cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c \
68:   cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h \
69:   cp/include/components/shell_task.h \
70:   cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h \
71:   cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h \
72:   cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c \
73:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c \
74:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c \
75:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c \
76:   cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h \
77:   projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
78: do
79:   cmp -s "$mirror/$path" "bk_avdk_smp/$path" || exit 1
80: done
81: ```
82: 
83: 全部`cmp`都必须返回0。
84: 
85: ## 3. 正确构建链条
86: 
87: 最终固件链条固定为：
88: 
89: ```text
90: OpenVela nuttx.bin
91:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
92:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
93:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
94:   -> package/all-app.bin
95: 
96: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
97:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
98: ```
99: 
100: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
101: 
102: - `ram_regions.csv`
103: - AP/CP `config`
104: - Kconfig 默认值
105: - 分区生成脚本
106: - SoC 链接脚本
107: 
108: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的

253: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
254: 
255: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 已收到成功 transport ACK、
256: `bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，`ap_console open`才允许进入；这是保守的
257: "MBUART 可写 + peer STATE ready"门禁，不代表 IPC power-up 和 PWC boot-ready 已由本桥
258: 独立验证。使用方式：
259: 
260: ```text
261: ap_console status
262: ap_console open
263: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
264: <at line start press Ctrl-], then .>
265: ap_console status
266: ```
267: 
268: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
269: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出转义只在行首识别，链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
270: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
271: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。

42: /****************************************************************************
43:  * Name: uart_xmitchars
44:  *
45:  * Description:
46:  *   This function is called from the UART interrupt handler when an
47:  *   interrupt is received indicating that there is more space in the
48:  *   transmit FIFO.  This function will send characters from the tail of
49:  *   the xmit buffer while the driver write() logic adds data to the head
50:  *   of the xmit buffer.
51:  *
52:  ****************************************************************************/
53: 
54: void uart_xmitchars(FAR uart_dev_t *dev)
55: {
56:   uint16_t nbytes = 0;
57:   irqstate_t flags = uart_spinlock(dev, true);
58: 
59:   /* Send while we still have data in the TX buffer & room in the fifo */
60: 
61:   while (dev->xmit.head != dev->xmit.tail && uart_txready(dev))
62:     {
63:       /* Send the next byte */
64: 
65:       if (dev->ops->sendbuf)
66:         {
67:           ssize_t sent;
68: 
69:           if (dev->xmit.tail < dev->xmit.head)
70:             {
71:               sent = dev->xmit.head - dev->xmit.tail;
72:             }
73:           else
74:             {
75:               sent = dev->xmit.size - dev->xmit.tail;
76:             }
77: 
78:           sent = uart_sendbuf(dev,
79:                               &dev->xmit.buffer[dev->xmit.tail],
80:                               sent);
81:           if (sent > 0)
82:             {
83:               dev->xmit.tail += sent;
84:               nbytes += sent;
85:             }
86:         }
87:       else
88:         {
89:           uart_send(dev, dev->xmit.buffer[dev->xmit.tail++]);
90:           nbytes++;
91:         }
92: 
93:       /* Increment the tail index */
94: 
95:       if (dev->xmit.tail >= dev->xmit.size)
96:         {
97:           dev->xmit.tail = 0;
98:         }
99:     }
100: 
101:   /* When all of the characters have been sent from the buffer disable the TX
102:    * interrupt.
103:    *
104:    * Potential bug?  If nbytes == 0 && (dev->xmit.head == dev->xmit.tail) &&
105:    * dev->xmitwaiting == true, then disabling the TX interrupt will leave
106:    * the uart_write() logic waiting to TX to complete with no TX interrupts.
107:    * Can that happen?
108:    */
109: 
110:   if (dev->xmit.head == dev->xmit.tail)
111:     {
112:       uart_disabletxint(dev);
113:     }
114: 
115:   /* If any bytes were removed from the buffer, inform any waiters that
116:    * there is space available.
117:    */
118: 
119:   if (nbytes)
120:     {
121:       uart_datasent(dev);
122:     }
123: 
124:   uart_spinunlock(dev, true, flags);
125: }

2074:  * Description:

2076:  *
2077:  ****************************************************************************/

2079: int uart_register(FAR const char *path, FAR uart_dev_t *dev)
2080: {
2081: #if defined(CONFIG_PM) && defined(CONFIG_SERIAL_CONSOLE)
2082:   char buf[NAME_MAX];
2083: #endif
2084:   int ret;
2085: 
2086: #if defined(CONFIG_TTY_SIGINT) || defined(CONFIG_TTY_SIGTSTP)
2087:   /* Initialize  of the task that will receive SIGINT signals. */
2088: 
2089:   dev->pid = INVALID_PROCESS_ID;
2090: #endif
2091: 
2092: #ifdef CONFIG_TTY_FORCE_PANIC
2093:   dev->panic_count = 0;
2094: #endif
2095: 
2096:   /* If this UART is a serial console */
2097: 
2098:   if (dev->isconsole)
2099:     {
2100:       /* Enable signals and echo by default */
2101: 
2102:       dev->tc_lflag |= ISIG | ECHO | ICANON;
2103: 
2104:       /* Enable \n -> \r\n translation for the console */
2105: 
2106:       dev->tc_oflag = OPOST | ONLCR;
2107: 
2108:       /* Convert CR to LF by default for console */
2109: 
2110:       dev->tc_iflag |= ICRNL;
2111: 
2112:       /* Clear escape counter */
2113: 
2114:       dev->escape = 0;
2115:     }
2116: 
2117:   /* Initialize mutex & semaphores */
2118: 
2119:   nxmutex_init(&dev->xmit.lock);
2120:   nxmutex_init(&dev->recv.lock);
2121:   nxmutex_init(&dev->closelock);
2122:   nxsem_init(&dev->xmitsem, 0, 0);
2123:   nxsem_init(&dev->recvsem, 0, 0);
2124:   rspin_lock_init(&dev->lock);
2125: 
2126: #ifdef CONFIG_SERIAL_TERMIOS
2127:   dev->timeout = 0;
2128:   dev->minread = 1;
2129: #endif

2131:   /* Register the serial driver */
2132: 
2133: #if defined(CONFIG_PM) && defined(CONFIG_SERIAL_CONSOLE)
2134:   snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "console-%s", basename((char *)path));
2135:   pm_wakelock_init(&dev->wakelock, buf, PM_IDLE_DOMAIN, PM_NORMAL);
2136: #endif

2142:       return ret;
2143:     }

103:  * Description:

107:  *

109:  *   no tasks were blocked waiting for the semaphore to become unlocked; the
110:  *   semaphore is simply incremented.
111:  *
112:  *   If the value of the semaphore resulting from this operation is zero,
113:  *   then one of the tasks blocked waiting for the semaphore shall be
114:  *   allowed to return successfully from its call to nxsem_wait().

123:  *
124:  * Assumptions:

355:  *
356:  * Description:
357:  *   Determine the smallest value of l2size (log base 2 size) such that the
358:  *   following is true:
359:  *
360:  *   size <= (1 << l2size)
361:  *
362:  * Input Parameters:
363:  *   size - The size of the region.
364:  *

**审查结论**
发现 2 个 Critical、3 个 High、5 个 Medium，以及 3 项关键缺失。当前代码不能因为构建通过而视为可上板交付。

**Critical**
1. **最终 `all-app.bin` 没有包含本次 AP 修改。**  
   [README.md](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md:233) 已明确记录 SMP 包复用了旧 AP 输入。只读哈希检查也确认：
   ```text
   当前 contest nuttx.bin           78d6a112...
   bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin b418fb2b...
   package/tmp/app1.bin              b418fb2b...
   ```
   因此刷现有 `all-app.bin` 时，本次 AP Mailbox V2 修改不会运行。  
   最小修复：用当前 `nuttx.bin` 覆盖 `build/openvela-ap.bin`，项目级 clean 后重建 SMP，并对三个 AP 输入执行 `cmp -s`。

2. **ACK pool 耗尽后会阻塞释放 ACK pool 所必需的入站 ACK，形成永久死锁。**  
   [bk7258_mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:140) 在 8 个 ACK slot 全部占用时令 `transport_rx_ready()` 返回 false；[bk7258_mbox0.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mbox0.c:165) 因而在读取报文头之前停止 drain。这样 matching command ACK 或 STATE probe ACK 也无法进入，而这些 ACK 正是 [release_acks_before()](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:174) 释放旧 slot 的唯一证据。高水位 probe 只能降低概率，不能消除满池竞态。  
   最小修复：RX admission 不能只由 ACK slot 数决定；必须始终允许 ACK/reset 被复制和处理。普通 command 在无 ACK slot 时保留于足够大的 AP RX descriptor queue，由 worker 延后处理，不能弹出后丢弃。

**High**
3. **STATE probe timeout 后链路实际上无法恢复。**  
   [bk7258_mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:605) 将超时的 `g_probe` 置为 quarantine 并进入 DOWN；再次调用 probe 时，[begin_abort()](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:262) 在启动 RESET 已发送的情况下不会分配新 RESET，而 [bk7258_mailbox_send_wire()](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:752) 又永久拒绝复用 quarantined probe slot。`g_probe_attempts` 在新恢复周期也没有复位。  
   最小修复：超时 probe 保持 quarantine，另配独立稳定 probe slot/epoch；新的 RESET+STATE 恢复成功后再依据 FIFO 顺序释放旧 slot。不能直接清 `quarantine` 后复用原地址。

4. **远端明确报告 DATA 未接收时，AP 仍推进 TX ring，确定性丢字节。**  
   [bk7258_mb_uart.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mb_uart.c:167) 对所有失败结果都推进 `tx_read`。其中 `uart_tx_fail=1` 明确表示 CP 未接收整个 chunk，不存在重复消费的不确定性；当前处理会静默丢掉最多 128 字节控制台输出，也与计划“失败不推进”不一致。  
   最小修复：仅 timeout/peer reset 这类消费状态未知的结果允许按策略丢弃；`COM_FAIL`/`uart_tx_fail` 保留 ring tail，完成 RESET+STATE 后有界重试一次。

5. **CP 在硬件 ISR 中解引用未经地址校验的 AP envelope 指针。**  
   [mbox0_adapter.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:112) 只检查 SID 上界和长度，随后在 [第 126 行](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:126) 直接 `memcpy((void *)msg->data[0])`。损坏、stale 或恶意 envelope 可使 CPU0 在中断上下文 BusFault，cache 操作甚至先于复制执行。  
   最小修复：在任何 cache/memcpy 前校验真实 SID、4 字节对齐、`address + 16` 无溢出，并精确限制到 AP RAM envelope 白名单；非法 envelope 只计数并丢弃。

**Medium**
6. **transport 唯一 worker 在链路状态变化时执行阻塞 `printf`。**  
   [bk7258_mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:627) 的线程同时承担 timeout、ACK dispatch 和 reset/probe；进入 DOWN 后 [txready()](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mb_uart.c:642) 返回 false。如果 NuttX console xmit ring 已满，该 `printf` 可等待永远，连后续 ACK 都不能发送。  
   最小修复：transport worker 内只更新计数和投递非阻塞事件；日志放到独立诊断 worker，且必须允许短写。

7. **CP Mailbox ISR 路径仍直接打日志。**  
   硬件 ISR 经 [mbox0_adapter.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:133) 同步进入 logical/MB_UART callback；其中 stale ACK/reset 在 [mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:344) 和 [第 410 行](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:410) 调用 `BK_LOGW`，非法 DATA/STATE 也在 [mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:235) 打日志。这会进入 shell log 分配/锁路径，带来 ISR 延迟和递归锁风险。  
   最小修复：ISR 只累加原子计数并唤醒 worker；格式化日志完全移出 ISR。

8. **`ap_console open` 没有 IPC power-up/PWC boot-ready 门禁。**  
   [driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:349) 仅用 MB_UART STATE/write-ready 判断 ready，[shell_task.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:1911) 据此允许切换；[README.md](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md:255) 也明确承认缺少组合门禁。用户可能被切到尚未启动 NSH 或 board bring-up 未完成的 AP。  
   最小修复：bridge ready 条件同时要求 MB_UART probe、IPC power-up 和 PWC boot-ready 三个独立事件。

9. **未实现 Mailbox PM，也没有禁止破坏链路的睡眠。**  
   CP shell 在 [shell_task.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2090) 空闲后释放 sleep vote；bridge 没有持有 Mailbox/AP console 的 PM vote，AP 侧也没有 MBOX suspend/resume 重配。睡眠后双方仍可能保留 READY 和旧 slot 所有权。  
   最小修复：第一版在 bridge/Mailbox 活跃期间持有禁止 deep sleep 的 vote；实现 PM 后按 RESET+STATE 重新探测再恢复 READY。

10. **设备注册失败被静默忽略，且 Kconfig 开关不能真实关闭功能。**  
   [bk7258_serial.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:241) 忽略两个 `uart_register()` 结果，失败后仍可继续 PWC ready。另一方面 [Make.defs](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/Make.defs:15) 和 [CMakeLists.txt](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/CMakeLists.txt:12) 无条件编译 serial/mbox/channel，而只条件编译 `bk7258_mb_uart.c`；关闭 `BK7258_MBOX_V2` 会产生引用错误，关闭 console 也仍注册 `/dev/console`。  
   最小修复：检查并传播注册错误；分别以 `BK7258_MBOX_V2` 和 `BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` 条件编译 transport、MB_UART、serial/syslog 注册路径。

**关键缺失**
- [check_swap_layout.sh](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/check_swap_layout.sh:49) 只是把 CSV 与另一个硬编码常量比较；header 和 [ld.script](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/scripts/ld.script:23) 仍各自硬编码，也没有最终比较 Armino 生成的 `ram_regions.h`，不满足计划中的单一来源要求。当前 map 地址正确，但无法防止后续漂移。
- `bk7258_mbox_send()` 对 destination 2 仍读取 channel 1 状态：[bk7258_mbox0.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mbox0.c:129)。UART0 当前只发 CPU0，因此不是本轮主路径故障，但共享 API 对 CPU2 是错误的。
- 未发现针对 ACK pool 满、probe timeout、stale ACK、peer reset、非法 envelope 和 RX 整包拒绝的主机侧状态机测试或故障注入测试。现有证据仅覆盖编译、链接和打包，不覆盖这些运行时所有权条件。

权威 CP 覆盖中的五个核心文件与 `bk_avdk_smp` 工作树逐字节一致，实际 CP build graph 也包含 `driver.c`、`shell_task.c`、`mailbox_channel.c`、`mb_uart_driver.c` 和 `mbox0_adapter.c`；这部分未发现 CMake 漏源。全程只读，未修改任何文件。
